agent-loop.en:
"So how does an agent actually work? It does not answer in 1 shot like a chatbot. It works on repeat until the job is done. [Point at the circle] Think: plan the next step. Act: use 1 tool. Check: did it work? Am I done? Is this safe? If not done, round again.

Watch it on 1 WhatsApp order from Jaya Grocer. Round 1: find the item. It searches and finds big onions, 10 kg bags, 42 bags in stock. Round 2: check the credit limit and term. The order is RM560, and only RM180 is left on the credit limit. Round 3: over the credit limit and term. The rule says the boss decides. So it sends the request for approval and waits.

That is the whole idea. It loops until the job is done, then reports to you. Or, when it is unsure or the step is risky, it stops and asks a person."

Next: "Think of it like hiring a new graduate."
agent-loop.zh:
“那 AI Agent 到底是怎么做事的？它不像聊天机器人那样一次就回答。它会 repeat 做事，直到完成。[指着圆圈] 想：计划下一步。做：用 1 个工具。检查：成功了吗？做完了吗？安全吗？还没做完，就再绕一圈。

我们用 Jaya Grocer 的 1 张 WhatsApp 订单来看。第 1 轮：找 item。它搜一搜，找到大洋葱、10 kg 装，库存 42 包。第 2 轮：查 credit limit & term。订单是 RM560，credit limit 只剩 RM180。第 3 轮：超出 credit limit & term。规则说老板决定。所以它把申请送去批准，然后等。

整个概念就是这样。它一直循环，直到做完，再向你汇报。或者，遇到不确定、或者步骤有风险，它就停下来问人。”

下一页：“你可以把它想成请一个刚毕业的新人。”

ai-history.en:
"Before we open up the brain, 1 minute of history, because ChatGPT did not come from nowhere. 70 years, 5 big steps. Let me open them 1 by 1."

(Next) Rules, 1950s to 80s: "Think of a recipe book: the computer follows every step exactly. Watch this order of RM6,000: the rule says over the credit limit, block it. You use rules every day: Excel formulas, the credit-limit check in SQL Account. The problem: a new situation with no rule, and it is stuck."

(Next) Machine learning, 2000s: "Think of a clerk who has seen 10,000 invoices and just knows who pays late. You show the computer past customers, green paid on time, orange paid late. It finds the line between them by itself. Then a new customer comes in: Kedai Ali, 80 percent chance of paying late. That is how spam filters and credit scores work. But it needs neat tables, and 1 model answers only 1 question."

(Next) Deep learning, 2012: "Think of a child who learns what a cat is by seeing 1,000 cats. Many layers look at a photo, layer by layer, and it says: damaged carton, 94 percent sure. Face unlock, Siri, Google Translate all work like this. In your company: reading a handwritten order or a bank slip. But each model does only 1 job, and it cannot talk with you."

(Next) LLM, 2018 to 2020: "Think of your phone's autocomplete, but it read the whole internet. The customer asks: can you deliver tomorrow? It writes: yes, we can deliver... and for the next word it scores every option: tomorrow 82 percent. It picks it. Then the next word, and the next. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek. It replies to emails, summarises PDFs. But it only talks; it cannot act in your systems."

(Next) AI agents, 2025: "Think of a new staff member. It reads the WhatsApp order, checks the stock, drafts the Sales Order, and then asks you to approve. Round and round the loop until the job is done. That is where we are today."

This slide has 5 extra Next presses; each card flies in, in 3D, and plays its own short animation.
Next: "Now let's open up the brain of today's AI: the LLM."
ai-history.zh:
“在打开这个大脑之前，先花 1 分钟讲历史，因为 ChatGPT 不是凭空冒出来的。70 年，5 大步。我们一步一步打开来看。”

（下一步）规则，1950 到 80 年代：“想象一本食谱：电脑一步一步照做。看这张 RM6,000 的订单：规则说超过信用额度，就挡下。你每天都在用规则：Excel 公式、SQL Account 的信用额度检查。问题是：遇到没写规则的新情况，它就卡住。”

（下一步）机器学习，2000 年代：“想象一个看过 10,000 张 Invoice 的老文员，一看就知道谁会迟付。你给电脑看过去的顾客，绿色是准时付款，橙色是迟付。它自己找出两者之间的那条线。然后来了一个新顾客：Kedai Ali，80% 的机会会迟付。垃圾邮件过滤和信用评分都是这样运作的。但它需要整齐的表格，而且 1 个模型只答 1 个问题。”

（下一步）深度学习，2012 年：“想象一个小孩，看过 1,000 只猫，就认得什么是猫。很多层一层一层看一张照片，然后说：破损纸箱，94% 确定。刷脸解锁、Siri、Google Translate 都是这样运作的。在你公司：读手写订单或银行单据。但每个模型只做 1 件事，而且它不会跟你聊天。”

（下一步）LLM，2018 到 2020 年：“想象手机的自动补字，只是它读过整个互联网。顾客问：明天可以送货吗？它写：好的，我们会在……下一个词，它给每个选项打分：明天 82%。它选了这个。然后再下一个词，再下一个。ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek。它会回 Email、总结 PDF。但它只会说，不能在你的系统里做事。”

（下一步）AI Agent，2025 年：“想象一个新员工。它读 WhatsApp 订单、查库存、开 Sales Order 草稿，然后请你批准。一圈一圈做，直到把事情做完。这就是我们今天所在的位置。”

这一页有 5 次额外的下一步；每张卡片以 3D 方式飞进来，播放它自己的小动画。
下一页：“现在我们来打开今天 AI 的大脑：LLM。”

ai-team.en:
"You do not get one AI that does everything. You get a team, like your own office. One takes orders. One watches stock. One chases payments. And they all follow one rule: the AI handles the normal cases, and the special cases go to a person to decide. Enough slides. Let me show you a working day."

Next: "Enough talking. Let me show you."
ai-team.zh:
“你得到的不是一个什么都做的 AI，而是一个团队，就像你自己的办公室。一个接订单，一个看库存，一个追款。它们都遵守一条规则：一般情况 AI 处理，特别情况交给人做决定。幻灯片讲够了，我让你看看一个工作日。”

下一页：“讲够了。我来做给你看。”

brain-to-staff.en:
"A brilliant brain alone only talks. Think about hiring a brilliant graduate: talent is not enough. You give them 6 things, and an AI Agent needs the same 6.

[Go down the list] A job description: for the AI, its instructions: the goal, and when the job counts as done. Without it, it does too much, or the wrong job. Logins and keys: its tools, 1 for each action. Without them, it can only give advice. The files: its memory: your records, and what you taught it. Without it, it forgets the customer and guesses the price. Your SOP: its rules and skills. Without them, it does the job its own way. A supervisor: permission, who says yes. Without it, nobody checks before stock or money moves. And probation: testing. You try it on last month's orders first, then you watch it. Without that, the same mistake repeats quietly.

The brain plus this setup has a name: the harness. Every company can rent the same brain. The harness decides whether it helps or hurts."

Next: "Now, let me ask you to imagine something."
brain-to-staff.zh:
“再聪明的大脑，单靠自己也只会讲。想想你请一个很优秀的毕业生：光有才华是不够的。你会给他 6 样东西，AI Agent 也需要同样这 6 样。

[一行一行往下讲] 职位说明：对 AI 来说就是指示，目标是什么，怎样才算做完。没有它，它会做太多，或者做错工作。账号和钥匙：就是它的工具，每个动作 1 个。没有它们，它只能给建议。档案：就是它的记忆，你的记录，还有你教过它的东西。没有它，它会忘记顾客、乱猜价格。你的 SOP：就是它的规则与技能。没有它们，它就照自己的方式做事。主管：就是权限，谁来点头。没有它，库存或钱动之前，没人把关。还有试用期：就是测试。你先拿上个月的订单试，然后盯着它做。没有这一步，同一个错误会静静地一直重复。

大脑加上这套配置，有个名字：harness，驾驭框架。每家公司都能租到同一个大脑。帮你还是害你，由 harness 决定。”

下一页：“现在，请大家想象一件事。”

closing.en: Leave this up while people talk to the team.
closing.zh: 大家和团队交流时，这页一直放着。

compare-llms.en:
"ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Llama. They are not all the same. When you pick one, compare 7 things.

1, how smart it is at your kind of work: writing, maths, reading documents. Do not only trust the rankings; test it on 10 of your own real orders. 2, how much it can read at once. DeepSeek V4 reads 1 million tokens, about 7 books. 3, cost: you pay per token, for what goes in and what comes out, so long PDFs and long chats cost more. 4, speed: how fast the words come out. Fast matters for chat; for an overnight report, slower is fine. 5, whether it thinks step by step before answering. Slower and costs more, but better on hard jobs. 6, size: the number of dials inside. Llama 3 comes in 8 billion or 70 billion; DeepSeek V4 Pro has 1.6 trillion. 7, how it is built. That one deserves its own slide."

Note: model figures from Meta (Llama 3) and the DeepSeek-V4 paper (2026). Prices change often, so no prices are on the slide.
Next: "So how is the brain built? Think of an office."
compare-llms.zh:
“ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek、Llama。它们不是都一样的。你要选的时候，比 7 样东西。

第一，它在你这类工作上有多聪明：写东西、算数、看文件。不要只信排行榜；拿你自己 10 张真实订单去测。第二，它一次能读多少。DeepSeek V4 能读 1 百万个 Token，大约 7 本书。第三，成本：按 Token 收费，读进去的和写出来的都算钱，所以长的 PDF 和长的聊天比较贵。第四，速度：字出来有多快。聊天要快；如果是隔夜的报表，慢一点也没关系。第五，它会不会先一步步思考再回答。慢一点，也贵一点，但难的工作做得更好。第六，大小：里面旋钮的数量。Llama 3 有 80 亿和 700 亿两种；DeepSeek V4 Pro 有 1.6 万亿。第七，它是怎么搭建的。这一样值得用一整页来讲。”

备注：模型数据来自 Meta（Llama 3）和 DeepSeek-V4 论文（2026）。价格常常变，所以页面上不放价格。
下一页：“那大脑是怎么搭建的？想象一间办公室。”

You save RM23,556 a month, a 92% cut in cost. That is about RM282,672 a year. The setup fee pays for itself in under 1 month. And the people you free up can move to serving customers and growing sales."

Note: this is an estimate, using the manual cost on the previous slide and a RM2,000 a month plan (Pro); say "estimate" out loud. It does not yet count what HRDF can cover.

cost-compare.zh:
“人手：每月 RM25,556。用 SuDu AI：每月 RM2,000。AI 做日常工作，人只负责批准。

每月省下 RM23,556，成本减少 92%。一年大约省下 RM282,672。安装费不到 1 个月就回本。省下来的人手，可以转去服务顾客、跟进业务。”

count-your-number.en:
"Let's put a number on all five problems, your own number. Three steps.

Step one: how many hours a week does your team spend on manual work, all staff added together? In my example: keying in orders ten hours, chasing payments eight, checking stock seven. Twenty-five hours a week.

Step two: times fifty-two weeks in a year.

Step three: times sixteen ringgit, roughly what one staff hour costs you with EPF and SOCSO.

Twenty-five times fifty-two times sixteen: twenty thousand eight hundred ringgit a year, spent on typing and chasing. Now work out your rough monthly staff cost and write it in your notes."

Do: one minute of silence. Coaches help with the sums.
Note: RM16 an hour is a staff member at about RM3,400 a month all-in, over 208 working hours. Adjust for your audience.
Next: "The usual answer is to hire another clerk. That only puts more people on the same typing. Can an AI Agent fix it? Only if it has 1 thing: tools."
count-your-number.zh:
“我们给这 5 个问题算一个数字，你自己的数字。三个步骤。

第一步：你的团队每个星期花多少小时在人手工作上？所有员工加起来。我的例子：输入订单十个小时，追收款八个小时，查库存七个小时。一个星期二十五个小时。

第二步：乘以一年五十二个星期。

第三步：乘以十六令吉，大约是一个员工一小时的成本，包括 EPF 和 SOCSO。

二十五乘五十二乘十六：一年两万零八百令吉，花在打单和追款上。现在把你每个月的人工 costing 大概算出来，写在笔记上。”

操作：安静一分钟。教练帮忙算。
备注：一小时 RM16 是一个月总成本大约 RM3,400 的员工，除以 208 个工作小时。按现场听众调整。
下一页：“一般的做法是再请一个文员。但那只是让更多人做同样的打字工作。AI Agent 能解决吗？只要它有 1 样东西：工具。”

Each next slide is 1 use case. Show it live, then come back to the slide.

demo-day.zh:
“我来介绍今天 demo 的 6 个 AI Agent。它们为 Maju Jaya Foods 工作，这是一家示范公司，用的是示范数据。Sasha 接订单。Ivan 看库存。Puteri 负责采购。Cody 追钱。Uma 把流失的顾客拉回来。Felix 管数字。我们先设定一次，然后每一个都在屏幕上做真正的工作。”

dense-moe.en:
"The last thing on the list: how the brain is built. There are 2 ways, and the easiest way to see them is an office.

Imagine your office gets 1 email.

The first way is called dense. Everyone reads every email. All 16 people stop and work on it." (point at the people lighting up) "It works, but it is slow and costly, and the bigger the office, the more every email costs.

The second way is called mixture of experts. A receptionist reads the email first and sends it only to the 2 people who know the topic. Everyone else keeps working on other things. So you can have a very big office, but each email is cheap and fast.

A real example: DeepSeek V4 has 1.6 trillion dials in total, but only 49 billion of them work on each word. That is why many of the newest models are built this way."

Note: figures from Meta (Llama 3) and the DeepSeek-V4 paper (June 2026). Llama 3 70B is dense: all 70B dials work on every word.
Next: "Whatever way it is built, every AI brain shares 1 big weakness."
dense-moe.zh:
“清单上最后一样：大脑是怎么搭建的。有两种方式，最容易看懂的方法，就是想象一间办公室。

假设你的办公室收到 1 封 Email。

第一种方式叫 Dense，稠密。每封 Email 人人都看。16 个人全部停下来处理它。”（指着亮起来的人）“行得通，但又慢又贵；办公室越大，每封 Email 的成本就越高。

第二种方式叫 Mixture of Experts，专家混合。前台先看这封 Email，然后只交给懂这个题目的 2 个人。其他人继续做别的事。所以你可以有一间非常大的办公室，但每封 Email 都便宜又快。

真实例子：DeepSeek V4 一共有 1.6 万亿个旋钮，但每个词只用到其中 490 亿个。这就是为什么很多最新的模型都是这样搭建的。”

备注：数据来自 Meta（Llama 3）和 DeepSeek-V4 论文（2026 年 6 月）。Llama 3 70B 是 Dense：全部 700 亿个旋钮都要处理每一个词。
下一页：“不管怎么搭建，每个 AI 大脑都有 1 个大弱点。”

They already use AI: orders come in by themselves, payments are chased faster, stock figures are right. In every industrial revolution, the ones who moved first took the customers. The gap grows every month.

Book your 45-minute Online Demo today, and see AI work on your own data. Sign within 14 days and get 20% off."

Next: questions.
dont-wait.zh:
（停一下，让第一句话停留。）“你可以再等一等。但是你的对手不会等你！

他们已经开始用 AI 了：订单自动进来，钱追得更快，库存数字准确。每一次工业革命，先行动的人都抢走了顾客。差距每个月都在拉大。

今天就预约 45 分钟 Online Demo，用你自己的数据看 AI 做事。14 天内签约，享有 20% 折扣。”

first-ai-job.en:
"Worksheet, box 3. Pick one job from the list, the one that would help your office most. Then write it in six lines, exactly the way you would explain it to a new clerk on their first day. When does it happen? What does it look at? What does it do? When should it not do it? When is it finished? Who does it tell? If you can explain it in six lines, an AI agent can do it."

Do: five minutes to pick, twelve to write, three to copy the number from box 1 next to it. Table hosts each choose one good example for the next slide.
Second example (take WhatsApp orders): WHEN a customer sends an order in the order group · LOOK AT price list, stock and credit limit · DO create the sales order and reply with a confirmation · UNLESS item unclear, stock short or over the limit · STOP WHEN the customer has the confirmation · TELL the sales manager when a rule is broken.
Next: "Who is brave enough to let us set theirs up, right now?"
first-ai-job.zh:
“作业纸，第 3 格。从清单里选一个工作，选最能帮到你办公室的那个。然后用 6 行写下来，就像你第一天跟新文员交代工作那样。什么时候做？看什么？做什么？什么情况不要做？什么时候算完成？要通知谁？如果你能用 6 行讲清楚，AI Agent 就能做。”

操作：5 分钟选，12 分钟写，3 分钟把第 1 格的数字抄在旁边。每位桌长各选一个好例子给下一页用。
第二个例子（接 WhatsApp 订单）：何时：客户在订单群发订单 · 看什么：价格表、库存和信用额度 · 做什么：建立 Sales Order 并回复确认 · 除非：货品不清楚、库存不够或超出额度 · 何时停：客户收到确认 · 通知谁：违反规则时通知销售经理。
下一页：“谁够胆，让我们现在就帮你设起来？”

five-stages.en:
"Think about the industrial revolutions: steam, then electricity, then computers. Each one changed who did the work, and the factories that moved first won. The same thing happens in how a company is run.

Business 1.0, until about 1980: handwritten. Orders in a book, stock counted by hand. Slow, and nobody sees the whole picture.

Business 2.0, the 1980s and 1990s: spreadsheets. Excel files passed around by email. Faster, but many versions and typing mistakes.

Business 3.0, from the 1990s until now: software. SQL Account, and a separate system for each team. Much better, but the systems do not talk, and people still key everything in. This is where most companies in this room are today.

Business 4.0 is already here. ChatGPT arrived at the end of 2022 and could only talk. Since 2025, AI agents do the work: they read the WhatsApp order, create the documents, chase the payment, inside an AI-native ERP, and people approve. That is what SuDu does today, and what you will see in the demo.

And business 5.0 is next: physical AI. Humanoid robots and self-driving trucks do the physical work, run by the same system. AI-native ERP plus robots: the autonomous enterprise.

(Pause while the competitor marker climbs.) Here is the point. The future is not coming; it is here. Your competitor can already be at 4.0 while you are at 3.0, and in every revolution so far, the ones who moved first took the customers. The gap grows every year."

Point at the two bars on each card: manual work and cost fall with every era, and fall the most at 4.0 and 5.0.
Note: the years are rounded eras, not exact dates; the manual-work and cost bars are an illustration, not measured figures. Physical AI timing (late 2020s) is an outlook, and it is not on sale today.
Next: "Now let's look at how SuDu is built, from the side."
five-stages.zh:
“想想工业革命：蒸汽，然后是电，然后是电脑。每一次都改变了由谁来做工作，而先行动的工厂都赢了。公司的运营方式也一样。

商业 1.0，大约到 1980 年：手写。订单写在簿子里，库存靠手点。很慢，也没人看得到全貌。

商业 2.0，1980 和 1990 年代：电子表格。Excel 文件用 Email 传来传去。快了一些，但版本很多，常常打错。

商业 3.0，从 1990 年代到现在：软件。SQL Account，加上每个部门各自一套系统。好很多，但系统之间不相通，人还是要把所有东西输入进去。今天在座大部分公司就在这里。

商业 4.0 已经来了。ChatGPT 在 2022 年底出现，当时只会聊天。从 2025 年起，AI Agent 开始做事：读 WhatsApp 订单、开单据、追款，在 AI 原生 ERP 里面完成，由人来批准。这就是 SuDu 今天在做的，等一下的演示你会看到。

接下来是商业 5.0：实体 AI。人形机器人和自动驾驶货车做体力活，由同一个系统驱动。AI 原生 ERP 加上机器人：自主运营的企业。

（等竞争对手的标记往上爬时停一下。）重点是：未来不是快要来，而是已经来了。你的竞争对手可能已经在 4.0，而你还在 3.0。到目前为止的每一次革命，先行动的人都抢走了顾客。差距每年都在扩大。”

指着每张卡上的两条柱：人手工作和成本每个时代都在下降，到 4.0 和 5.0 降得最多。
备注：年份是大概的时代划分，不是精确日期；人手工作和成本的柱只是示意，不是实测数字。实体 AI 的时间（2020 年代后期）只是展望，目前还没有销售。

foundation.en:
"The foundation is simple: scan it once, where it happens. In the warehouse, the storekeeper scans the carton when it arrives, when it goes on the shelf, when it is picked. No paper, no typing later. One of our customers cut their stock differences by ninety percent. In the factory it is the same idea: scan the job, record what was used and what was made. Another customer cut manual data entry by eighty percent. If you have no factory, ignore the right side. The point is the same. Scanned, not typed."

Note: the company profile credits -90% stock discrepancy to Twin Arrow and -80% manual data entry to BHPetrol. Name them only with permission.
Next: "On top of that clean data sits the AI team."
foundation.zh:
“地基很简单：在发生的地方，扫描一次。在仓库，货到的时候、上架的时候、拣货的时候，仓管员都扫描那一箱货。不用纸，不用事后打字。我们有一个顾客，库存差异减少了百分之九十。工厂也是同样的道理：扫描工单，记录用了什么、做出了什么。另一个顾客的人手输入减少了百分之八十。如果你没有工厂，右边可以不看。重点一样：靠扫描，不靠打字。”

Twenty-five mil clear, one piece: which item is that in your system, which code? And deliver before twelve: which day?

Nobody outside your office could decode this. But somebody inside your office does it, for every order, every day: opens the chat, guesses, checks the last order, looks up the codes, and types it into SQL Account."

(Next: a PDF purchase order slides in.) "Some customers are neater. They send a PDF purchase order. Better, but somebody still has to match their stock code to yours, check the price and the unit, a bag of ten or one, and key every line into SQL Account. Then the next PO." (The PO is a mock-up with made-up names.)

“这是一张真实的订单，来自真实的顾客聊天。跟你同桌的人一起看：这位顾客到底订了什么？给你们二十秒。”（停一下，让两桌回答。）

（下一步：问号出现。）“China：是标题、品牌，还是洋葱的产地？Bwg besar，十公斤，乘以多少？几包？Ayam cincang，八 ekor，乘以多少？二十五 mil clear，一个：在你的系统里是哪个货品、哪个编号？还有十二点前送货：是哪一天？

公司外面的人根本看不懂。但你公司里面有人在破解它，每张订单、每一天：打开聊天、猜、翻查上一张订单、找编号，然后打进 SQL Account。”

（下一步：一张 PDF Purchase Order 滑进来。）“有些顾客比较整齐，他们发 PDF Purchase Order。好一点，但还是要有人把对方的货品编号对上你的，核对价格和单位，一包十个还是一个，然后逐行输入 SQL Account。接着是下一张 PO。”（这张 PO 是模拟的，名字都是虚构的。）

harness.en:
"Here is the most important idea in AI right now. Everyone can rent the same brain: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini. So where is the difference? In the setup around the brain. It is called the harness: the tools, the memory, the rules, the permission, the loop, and the tests.

Proof: the same brains power the chat apps and the coding tools like Claude Code and Codex. The chat app answers a question. The coding tool can work for hours on its own, writing and testing code. Same brain. Different harness.

And the part that matters most is the loop. Designing it has a name: loop engineering. In plain words, 3 questions. The steps: what does it do, in what order, with which small tools? When to stop: what does done mean? Done means the sales order is drafted and sent for approval. And when to ask a person: anything with money, any doubt, any risk. Plus: it checks every step, logs everything, and when a tool fails, it retries once, then reports. Never guesses.

So remember: the brain is rented. The harness is built. A better harness beats a bigger brain."

Next: "And 1 part of that harness matters more than people think: the tools."
harness.zh:
“这是现在 AI 最重要的一个概念。每个人都能租到同一个大脑：ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini。那差别在哪里？在大脑周围的配置。它叫 harness，驾驭框架：工具、记忆、规则、权限、循环，还有测试。

证据：聊天 app 和 Claude Code、Codex 这些写程序的工具，背后是同样的大脑。聊天 app 回答一个问题。写程序的工具可以自己连做好几个小时，写程序、测程序。同一个大脑，不同的 harness。

而最重要的部分是循环。设计循环有个名字：循环设计。用白话讲，就是 3 个问题。步骤：它做什么、按什么顺序、用哪些小工具？何时停：怎样才算做完？做完的意思是，Sales Order 起草好了，也送去批准了。何时问人：只要涉及钱、有任何疑问、有任何风险。另外：它每一步都检查，什么都记录，工具出错时，它重试 1 次，然后汇报。绝不乱猜。

所以记住：大脑是租来的。harness 是自己建的。更好的 harness，胜过更大的大脑。”

下一页：“而 harness 里有 1 个部分，比大家想的更重要：工具。”

how-it-learned.en:
"So how did it learn? Inside the brain are billions of numbers. Think of them as tiny volume dials. Learning simply means turning those dials, a little at a time, until its guesses come out right.

Here is the loop." (follow the steps) "1: take a sentence, hide the next word, and guess it. 2: check the real word. 3: adjust; turn the dials a tiny bit toward the right answer. 4: repeat with the next sentence. Trillions of times. That takes months, tens of thousands of computer chips, and for the biggest models, over 100 million US dollars.

After that loop, 2 more stages. It gets coached by people: people wrote example answers and rated its answers, better or worse, so it learned to follow instructions and to be helpful and polite. Like a graduate on probation.

Then it is frozen. The dials are locked. Its knowledge stops at a cut-off date, and it does not learn from your chat as you talk."

Note: costs and chip counts are rough public estimates for the largest models; say "about".
Next: "So when you ask it something, how does it write the answer?"
how-it-learned.zh:
“那它是怎么学的？大脑里面有几十亿个数字。你可以把它们想成一个个小小的音量旋钮。学习就是转这些旋钮，一点一点转，直到它猜得准。

这就是那个循环。”（跟着步骤讲）“第一：拿一句话，把下一个词遮起来，让它猜。第二：对照真正的词。第三：调整，把旋钮往正确答案那边转一点点。第四：换下一句，再来一次。重复几万亿次。这要花好几个月，用几万块电脑芯片；最大的模型，要花超过 1 亿美金。

这个循环之后，还有两个阶段。第一，有人来教它：人写了示范答案，也给它的答案打分，好一点还是差一点，所以它学会听指令，学会帮忙、有礼貌。就像一个还在试用期的毕业生。

然后，它就被冻结了。旋钮锁住了。它的知识停在一个截止日期，你跟它聊天的时候，它不会从你的聊天里学东西。”

备注：成本和芯片数量是最大模型的公开粗略估计；讲的时候说“大约”。
下一页：“那你问它问题的时候，它是怎么写出答案的？”

how-much-it-read.en:
"ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek. You know the names. Inside each one is the same thing: an LLM, a large language model. Large, because it was trained on a huge amount of data: websites, books, news, in more than 100 languages. Language, because words go in and words come out. Model, because it learned the patterns of how people write, so it can guess the next word, 1 at a time. It reads text in small pieces called tokens; 1 token is about three quarters of a word."

(Next) "Quick guess. To learn language, how much did it read? A, 10,000 books. B, 1 million. C, 20 million. D, 100 million. Stacked up, A is a 70-storey tower. B is 6 Mount Kinabalus. C goes past the space station. D is 6 times higher than the space station. If you read 1 book a day, A takes you 27 years. D takes you 274,000 years. Raise your hand: A? B? C? D?" (count the hands, then Next)

(Next) "Who said D? Still not enough. Take DeepSeek V4, from 2026: about 240 million books of 400 pages, more than 2 times D. In tokens, those small pieces of text, that is more than 32 trillion. 2 years earlier, Llama 3 read 15 trillion, about 110 million books, so it doubled in 2 years.

Watch: if you stacked the books..." (the pile reaches the top of the Twin Towers) "...that is 1 Twin Tower. Keep going." (the view pulls back) "13,000 Twin Towers. The pile is about 6,000 km tall, 15 times higher than the space station. Laid flat, the books would cover 800 football fields." (the view changes to Earth and Moon) "And if you tore out every page and laid them end to end, they would reach the Moon 50 times over."

Note: rough figures from the published token counts (DeepSeek-V4 paper: 32T+ tokens; Meta: Llama 3, 15T+). Working: 1 token = 0.75 word; a 400-page book = 100,000 words, 2.5 cm thick, 12 x 20 cm pages; a football field = 7,140 m2. Say "about". The stack itself does not reach the Moon; the pages laid end to end do.
This slide has 2 extra Next presses: the LLM intro, the guess (A to D; the real answer is even bigger than D), then the 32 trillion scene.
Next: "So it is a very clever brain. But can it do your work? Not on its own."
how-much-it-read.zh:
“ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek，这些名字大家都听过。它们里面都是同一样东西：LLM，大型语言模型。大型，是因为它用海量数据训练：网站、书本、新闻，100 多种语言。语言，是因为文字进去，文字出来。模型，是因为它学会了人写字的规律，所以能一个字一个字猜出下一个。它把文字切成小块来读，叫做 Token；1 个 Token 大约是四分之三个英文词。”

（下一步）“猜一猜。为了学会语言，它读了多少？A，1 万本书。B，100 万本。C，2,000 万本。D，1 亿本。叠起来的话，A 是一栋 70 层高楼。B 是 6 座神山。C 超过太空站。D 比太空站高 6 倍。如果你一天读 1 本书，A 要 27 年，D 要 274,000 年。举手：A？B？C？D？”（数一数举手的人，再按 Next）

（下一步）“谁选 D？还是不够。拿 DeepSeek V4 来说，2026 年的：大约 2.4 亿本 400 页的书，是 D 的 2 倍多。换成 Token，就是刚才说的那些小块文字，超过 32 万亿个。2 年前，Llama 3 读了 15 万亿，大概 1.1 亿本书，所以 2 年就翻了一倍。

看好了，如果把这些书叠起来……”（书堆叠到双峰塔顶）“……这是 1 座双峰塔。继续。”（画面往后拉）“13,000 座双峰塔。这堆书大概 6,000 公里高，比太空站高 15 倍。平铺下来，这些书可以盖满 800 个足球场。”（画面换成地球和月球）“如果把每一页撕下来，首尾相接排好，可以到月球 50 趟。”

备注：数字是根据公开的 Token 数粗略估算的（DeepSeek-V4 论文：32T+ Token；Meta：Llama 3，15T+）。算法：1 个 Token ≈ 0.75 个英文词；一本 400 页的书 = 100,000 个词，2.5 公分厚，书页 12 x 20 公分；一个足球场 = 7,140 平方米。讲的时候说“大概”。书堆本身没有到月球；是书页首尾相接才到。
这一页多按 2 次 Next：先讲 LLM 是什么，再猜一猜（A 到 D，真正的答案比 D 还大），最后播 32 万亿的画面。
下一页：“所以它是一个很聪明的大脑。但它能帮你做事吗？单靠它自己，不行。”

layers-3d.en:
"Here is how SuDu is built, one layer at a time. It starts with the foundation: SQL Account."

(Next: the plate flips up.) Layer 1, SQL Account: "Your accounting. Invoices, credit notes, payments, e-invoice, tax, your P&L. It keeps your accounts right, and it records what has already happened. Every document SuDu creates goes down here automatically."

(Next: WMS lands on top.) Layer 2, WMS: "On top sits the warehouse. Receiving, putting on the shelf, picking, packing, delivery, transfers, counts, batch and expiry. Every carton is scanned the moment it moves, so the stock figure is always true."

(Next: MES lands on top.) Layer 3, MES: "If you manufacture, the factory. The BOM, the production order, material issue, output, QC, scrap and machine time. Every job planned, tracked and costed as it happens."

(Next: AI agents land on top.) Layer 4, AI agents: "And on top, the AI agents, reading every layer below and doing the routine work. Nothing is saved until a person approves."

(Next: all four fold into the stack.) "4 layers, 1 system. Each stands on the one below, and the AI runs them all."

This slide has 5 extra Next presses.
Next: "That is SuDu. Now let's talk about you."
layers-3d.zh:
“这就是 SuDu 的结构，一层一层来看。先从地基开始：SQL Account。”

（下一步：底板翻起来。）第 1 层，SQL Account：“你的会计。Invoice、Credit Note、付款、e-Invoice、税务、你的 P&L。它让你的账目正确，记录的是已经发生的事。SuDu 开出的每张单据都会自动进到这里。”

（下一步：WMS 落在上面。）第 2 层，WMS：“上面是仓库。收货、上架、拣货、打包、送货、转仓、盘点、Batch 和有效期。每一箱一动就扫描，所以库存数字永远是真的。”

live-in-30-days.en:
"Starting takes just 3 steps.

Step 1, AI setup: we connect your SQL Account safely with the SuDu sync tool. Customers, items, prices, stock and credit limits sync across on their own, and nothing writes straight into your database. We also set permissions: who can approve what.

Step 2, train the AI: just like teaching a new staff member. Write your way of working as Skills and SOPs, for example when to chase a payment, and who to ask when an order is over the credit limit. Then match the item codes: when a customer writes “bwg besar”, the AI has to know which item code that is in your system. We test it first with your orders from last month.

Step 3, start using your AI: it takes orders, chases payments, checks stock and makes reports. At first it only drafts, nothing is saved until you approve, and every action is logged. Once you trust it, add jobs 1 at a time.

We need 3 things from you: your data, 1 approver and 1 daily user."

Next: "So what does manual work really cost you?"
live-in-30-days.zh:
“开始只要 3 步。

第 1 步，AI 设置：我们用 SuDu 同步工具安全连接你的 SQL Account。顾客、货品、价格、库存和信用额度自动同步过来，不直接写进你的数据库。同时设好权限，谁能批准什么。

第 2 步，训练 AI：就像教新员工。把你的做法写成 Skill 和 SOP，比如什么时候追款、超过信用额度要问谁。然后对上货品编号：顾客写“bwg besar”，AI 要知道就是你系统里的哪个 item code。我们先用你上个月的订单测试。

第 3 步，开始用你的 AI：它开始接单、追款、查库存、做报表。一开始只出草稿，你批准了才保存，每个动作都有记录。信任建立后，再一个一个加工作。

我们需要你提供 3 样：你的数据、一位批准人、一位每天使用的人。”

llm-how.en:
"So how does it actually work? 5 steps, from reading the internet to writing your reply."

(Next) 1, learn: "It read the internet, websites, books, news, in over 100 languages, and played 1 game: guess the next word. Check. Adjust. Repeat, trillions of times. But notice: it never saw your company. Not your prices, your stock, your chats or your SOP."

(Next) 2, cut: "It does not read words. It cuts text into small pieces called tokens. This WhatsApp order: 9 words, 16 tokens. 1 token is about three quarters of a word. Why care? You pay per token, and it can hold about 1 million tokens at once, about 7 books."

(Next) 3, map: "How does it understand? Every word gets a place on a giant map of meaning. Words used the same way sit close together: bawang, onion and the Chinese word for onion. Even bwg lands right next to bawang. That is why it understands BM, English, Chinese and short forms."

(Next) 4, write: "When it answers, it plays the same game. Nasi lemak is usually eaten for..." (let the room answer) "...breakfast, 82 percent. It picks the most likely word, then the next, and the next. That is how it writes."

(Next) 5, watch out: "Because it always gives the most likely answer, with no facts it guesses, and still sounds sure. Ask it Kedai Ali's credit limit: RM10,000. Made up. AI people call this hallucination. The fix: let it look up your records, RM5,000, only RM180 left, and a person checks anything important."

This slide has 5 extra Next presses.
Note: token numbers and percentages are illustrations.
Next: "So a brain alone can only talk, and it guesses. People gave it hands and limits. That is the AI Agent."
llm-how.zh:
“那它到底是怎么运作的？5 个步骤，从读遍互联网，到写出给你的回复。”

（下一步）1，学习：“它读遍互联网，网站、书、新闻，100 多种语言，只玩 1 个游戏：猜下一个词。检查。调整。重复，几万亿次。但注意：它从来没见过你的公司。没见过你的价格、你的库存、你的聊天，也没见过你的 SOP。”

（下一步）2，切块：“它不是一个词一个词读的。它把文字切成小块，叫 Token。这张 WhatsApp 订单：9 个词，16 个 Token。1 个 Token 大约是四分之三个词。为什么要管这个？因为你是按 Token 付钱的，而且它一次能装大约 1 百万个 Token，差不多 7 本书。”

（下一步）3，地图：“它怎么看得懂？每个词在一张很大的意思地图上都有一个位置。用法一样的词靠得很近：bawang、onion，还有中文的洋葱。连 bwg 也落在 bawang 旁边。所以它看得懂马来文、英文、中文，还有简写。”

（下一步）4，写字：“它回答的时候，玩的还是同一个游戏。Nasi lemak 一般是当作……”（让大家回答）“……早餐，82%。它选最可能的那个词，然后下一个，再下一个。它就是这样写的。”

（下一步）5，小心：“因为它永远给最可能的答案，没有事实的时候，它就乱猜，还讲得很肯定。问它 Kedai Ali 的信用额度：RM10,000。乱编的。AI 圈子叫这个做幻觉。解决方法：让它查你的记录，RM5,000，只剩 RM180，重要的事再由人来检查。”

这一页要多按 5 次 Next。
备注：Token 数和百分比只是举例。
下一页：“所以大脑单靠自己只会讲，而且会乱猜。大家给了它双手和限制。这就是 AI Agent。”

machine-learning.en:
"Step 2 on that timeline, machine learning, is still everywhere, so let me show you what it does.

No rules written by hand. You give it past examples, for example 3 years of invoices. It finds the pattern by itself. And then it predicts 1 thing: Kedai Ali, 80 percent chance of paying late.

(point at the 3 questions) That is the key: 1 model answers 1 question. Who will pay late, from past invoices. How much will we sell next month, from past sales. Which items will run out this week, from stock movements.

You may hear some names. Random forest: many small decision trees vote. XGBoost and LightGBM: trees that fix each other's mistakes, built for big tables. CNN: a network that looks at pictures, like reading a handwritten order. You don't need to remember them.

The difference with what comes next: machine learning answers 1 question, from numbers in a table. An LLM answers any question, in plain words."

Note: the 80% is an illustration.
Next: "Then came the LLM."
machine-learning.zh:
“时间线上的第 2 步，机器学习，到现在还到处都在用，所以我给大家看看它做什么。

不用人手写规则。你给它过去的例子，比如 3 年的 Invoice。它自己找出规律。然后它预测 1 件事：Kedai Ali，有 80% 可能会迟付款。

（指着 3 个问题）重点在这里：1 个模型只回答 1 个问题。谁会迟付款，从过去的 Invoice 学。下个月会卖多少，从过去的销售学。这个星期哪些货会卖完，从库存进出学。

你可能会听到一些名字。随机森林：很多小的决策树一起投票。XGBoost 和 LightGBM：一棵树修正另一棵树的错误，专门处理大表格。CNN：一种看图片的网络，比如读手写的订单。这些不用记。

跟接下来要讲的有什么不同？机器学习只回答 1 个问题，而且是从表格里的数字来回答。LLM 什么问题都能回答，而且用大白话。”

备注：80% 只是举例。
下一页：“然后，LLM 出现了。”

makes-things-up.en:
"Now you can understand its biggest weakness. Remember: it always picks the most likely next word. It is built to always give an answer. So when it has no facts, it does not stop. It guesses, with words that sound right. AI people call this hallucination.

Watch. Ask a brain with no facts: what is Kedai Ali's credit limit? It answers, very confidently: RM10,000. Completely made up. It has never seen Kedai Ali.

Now the same question, but it is allowed to look up the customer record first. RM5,000. They have already used RM4,820, so only RM180 is left. Correct, and you can see where the number came from.

So 3 rules for using AI in a business. 1: give it facts; let it look up your records instead of trusting what it remembers. 2: ask for the source; a good answer can show you where the number came from. 3: a person checks anything that moves money or stock."

Next: "A brain alone can only talk, and it guesses. So people added 6 things to the brain to make it work. That is the AI Agent."
makes-things-up.zh:
“现在你就能明白它最大的弱点了。记得：它永远挑最可能的下一个词。它天生就是一定要给答案的。所以没有事实的时候，它不会停。它会猜，用听起来很对的话来猜。AI 圈叫这个做幻觉。

看。问一个没有事实的大脑：Kedai Ali 的信用额度是多少？它非常有信心地回答：RM10,000。完全是编出来的。它从来没见过 Kedai Ali。

现在问同一个问题，但先让它去查客户记录。RM5,000。他们已经用了 RM4,820，所以只剩 RM180。正确，而且你看得到这个数字从哪里来。

所以，在生意上用 AI，有 3 条规则。第一：给它事实；让它去查你的记录，不要信它记得的东西。第二：问它出处；好的答案能告诉你这个数字从哪里来。第三：凡是动到钱或库存的，都要有人检查。”

下一页：“一个大脑单独只能讲话，还会乱猜。所以大家给大脑加了 6 样东西，让它能做事。这就是 AI Agent。”

map-detail.en:
"Now let's zoom in. Here is how SuDu runs a company, module by module, with the real documents.

On the left, the outside world. Customers order on WhatsApp or email; the AI reads the message and creates the order. Suppliers quote and invoice by email.

Sales handles quotation, sales order, sales invoice, customer payment, credit notes and returns. When a sales order is confirmed, two things can happen. If the goods are in stock, it goes to the warehouse as a goods delivery. If they need to be made, it goes to the factory as a production order.

Purchasing handles the requisition, the purchase order, the purchase invoice and returns. A purchase order turns into goods receiving in the warehouse.

The warehouse, WMS, is the centre: goods receiving, putting on shelves, picking, packing, goods delivery, stock counts and return receiving. Every carton is scanned, so the stock is accurate. It sends materials to the factory, and the factory sends finished goods back as a production receipt.

The factory, MES: the BOM, the production order, the schedule, material issue, reporting and QC, and the production receipt. Every job is visible.

Underneath everything sits accounting: SQL Account or AutoCount. Invoices, credit notes, payments and purchase invoices go into it automatically, so your accounts stay where they are.

Above the modules, the AI agents do the work at each step. And standing on the floor, the next step: humanoid robots in the warehouse and factory, and an auto-driving truck on the delivery route, all run by the same system."

Note: physical AI is the roadmap, not on sale today.
Next: "Now look at the same system from the side."
map-detail.zh:
“现在放大来看。这就是 SuDu 怎么运营一家公司，一个模块一个模块，用真正的单据来看。

左边是外面的世界。客户用 WhatsApp 或 Email 下单；AI 读信息，开出订单。供应商用 Email 报价、发 Invoice。

销售负责 Quotation、Sales Order、Sales Invoice、Customer Payment、Credit Note 和退货。Sales Order 确认之后，有两种情况。如果有现货，就到仓库变成 Goods Delivery。如果要生产，就到工厂变成 Production Order。

采购负责申请、Purchase Order、Purchase Invoice 和退货。Purchase Order 会变成仓库的 Goods Receiving。

仓库，WMS，是中心：收货、上架、拣货、打包、Goods Delivery、盘点和退货收货。每一箱都扫描，所以库存准确。它把材料送到工厂，工厂把成品送回来，变成生产入库。

工厂，MES：BOM、Production Order、排程、发料、报工和 QC，还有生产入库。每张工单都看得到。

所有东西下面是会计：SQL Account 或 AutoCount。Invoice、Credit Note、付款和 Purchase Invoice 都自动进去，所以你的账照样留在原来的地方。

模块上面，AI Agent 在每一步做事。站在现场的是下一步：仓库和工厂里的人形机器人，还有送货路线上的自动驾驶货车，全都由同一个系统来管。”

备注：实体 AI 是路线图，今天还没有在卖。
下一页：“现在从侧面看同一个系统。”

meaning-map.en:
"So how does it understand bwg besar? Here is the idea. While it reads, every piece gets a place on a giant map of meaning. Words that are used in the same way end up close together.

Look at the onions." (point) "Bawang, onion, and the Chinese word for onion all sit in the same spot, because people use them the same way. And bwg, the short form, lands right next to bawang. That is how it reads rojak, BM, English and Chinese mixed together.

The same happens everywhere: Milo next to Horlicks and teh tarik. Invoice next to bil and bayar. Esok next to tomorrow.

This picture is a sketch. The real map does not have 2 directions; it has thousands. But the idea is the same: close on the map means similar in meaning."

Note: the map is a simplified sketch of what AI people call embeddings.
Next: "So how did it build that map? It trained."
meaning-map.zh:
“那它是怎么看懂 bwg besar 的？道理是这样。它在读的时候，每一小块都会在一张巨大的‘意思地图’上有个位置。用法一样的词，最后就会靠在一起。

看这些洋葱。”（指）“Bawang、onion，还有中文的‘洋葱’，全部落在同一个位置，因为大家用它们的方式一样。还有 bwg 这个简写，就落在 bawang 旁边。所以它看得懂 rojak，马来文、英文、中文混在一起都没问题。

到处都是这样：Milo 旁边是 Horlicks 和 teh tarik。Invoice 旁边是 bil 和 bayar。Esok 旁边是 tomorrow。

这张图只是简图。真正的地图不是只有 2 个方向，而是有几千个。但道理一样：在地图上靠得近，意思就相近。”

备注：这张地图是简化版，AI 圈叫 embeddings。
下一页：“那这张地图是怎么建出来的？靠训练。”

need-wms-mes.en:
"First question for your company: how big does the house need to be? 2 short lists, 5 questions each. Tick every yes, and count each side on its own.

WMS, the warehouse: more than 1 warehouse or many racks; staff wasting time looking for stock; batch or expiry dates, or stock thrown away because it expired; a stock count that does not match the system; more than 30 orders a day to pick and pack. Every yes is a problem a WMS fixes.

MES, the factory: you make, mix or assemble your own products; you issue raw materials by a recipe or BOM; you cannot tell how far a job has gone; the real cost or waste of each batch is unclear; you plan production on paper or in Excel.

Score: 0, SQL Account plus AI agents is enough for now. 1 or 2, start with the agents and add it later. 3 or more, you need it, so plan it from day 1.

If you do not make anything, skip the MES side: it is 0."

Do: coaches note both scores on the lead sheet next to the readiness score.
Next: "So how do you start? Just 3 steps."
need-wms-mes.zh:
“你公司的第一个问题：房子要盖多大？2 张短清单，每张 5 题。每个‘是’打勾，两边分开算。

WMS，仓库这边：超过 1 个仓库或很多货架；员工浪费时间找货；要跟 Batch 或有效期，或常因过期丢货；盘点数和系统对不上；每天超过 30 张订单要拣货打包。每一个‘是’，都是 WMS 能解决的问题。

MES，工厂这边：你自己生产、调配或组装产品；你按配方或 BOM 发原料；你不知道一张单做到哪一步；你不清楚每批的真实成本或损耗；你用纸或 Excel 排生产。

计分：0 分，目前 SQL Account 加 AI Agent 就够了。1 或 2 分，先用 AI Agent，以后再加。3 分或以上，你需要它，所以第 1 天就要规划。

如果你没有生产任何东西，MES 那边就跳过：算 0 分。”

操作：教练把两个分数记在 lead sheet 上，写在准备度分数旁边。
下一页：“那要怎么开始？只要 3 步。”

next-step.en:
"You already did the hard part today. You have your number, your score and your first AI job. The next step is free: a 45-minute Online Demo, where we run your first AI job on your own data. If you already know you want to start, sign within 14 days and get 20% off."

Note: do not go back over the problem here. People who hesitate are afraid of choosing wrong: stress free, short, and a person approves everything.
Next: "And if you want to go deeper, 3 courses are coming."
next-step.zh:
“今天，最难的部分你已经做完了。你有了你的数字、你的分数和你的第一个 AI 工作。下一步是免费的：45 分钟 Online Demo，用你自己的数据把你的第一个 AI 工作跑给你看。如果你已经确定要开始，14 天内签约，享有 20% 折扣。”

备注：这里不要再回头讲问题。犹豫的人是怕选错：强调轻松、简短、所有东西都由人批准。
下一页：“如果你想再深入一点，我们有 3 个课程即将开课。”

next-word.en:
"So you ask it a question. How does it write the answer? It plays the same game it trained on. Nasi lemak is usually eaten for..." (let the room shout) "...breakfast. It scores every possible next word: breakfast 82 percent, lunch 9, dinner 6. It picks the most likely one, writes it, and then does the same for the next word, and the next. 1 word at a time, dozens of words a second. Sometimes it picks the second choice so it sounds natural; that is why you get a slightly different answer each time.

And now its 3 limits make sense. 1: it stopped learning on a certain date, so it knows nothing newer. 2: it has never seen your company: not your prices, your stock or your chats. 3: because it picks the most likely words, not checked facts, it can sound completely sure when it is wrong."

Note: the percentages are an illustration.
Next: "Because it always picks the most likely word, it has 1 big weakness."
next-word.zh:
“你问它一个问题。它怎么写答案？它玩的就是训练时那个游戏。Nasi lemak 通常是当……”（让全场一起喊）“……早餐吃的。它会给每个可能的下一个词打分：早餐 82%，午餐 9%，晚餐 6%。它挑最可能的那个，写出来，然后下一个词也一样，再下一个也一样。一次 1 个词，一秒几十个词。有时候它会挑第二个选择，让句子听起来自然一点；所以你每次问，答案都会有点不一样。

现在它的 3 个局限就说得通了。第一：它学到某一天就停了，之后的事它都不知道。第二：它从没见过你的公司：你的价格、你的库存、你的聊天，它都没见过。第三：因为它挑的是最可能的词，不是查过的事实，所以它错了的时候，也可以说得非常肯定。”

备注：百分比只是举例。
下一页：“因为它总是挑最有可能的词，所以它有 1 个大弱点。”

plans.en:
"4 plans, starting from Basic, and I will make it simple. Most companies in this room should start at [recommended plan]. Compare the yearly price with the number in your box 1."

TO CONFIRM: the highlighted row is Standard because taking WhatsApp orders, as shown in the demo, starts there. Change it if you pick another plan. Check prices are current.
Next: "And the fees are HRDF claimable."
plans.zh:
“4 个配套，从 Basic 开始，我讲简单一点。在座大部分公司应该从 [推荐配套] 开始。拿年费跟你第 1 格的数字比一比。”

待确认：高亮的那一行是 Standard，因为示范里的接 WhatsApp 订单是从这个配套开始有的。如果你选其他配套就改掉。确认价格是最新的。
下一页：“而且，费用可以申请 HRDF。”

plug-straight-in.en:
"Every week someone asks me: my nephew, or my IT guy, says he can connect ChatGPT, Claude or Codex straight to my SQL Account this weekend. Can he? Yes, he probably can. Here is what can go wrong.

One: no access control. It can read every figure and change any of them, and nothing asks you first. It is like giving a new temp the master key and the company chop on day one.

Two: it can freeze the server. SQL Account keeps its data in a database. One heavy question, like every sale for five years, can lock it, and nobody in the office can issue an invoice until it recovers.

Three: it messes up your accounts. Writing straight into the database skips SQL Account's own checks: the running numbers, the stock update, the accounts. Your records stop matching each other, and you may not notice for months.

So the agent is not the danger. Direct access is. The safe way is a proper connection: permission for every user, a person approves before anything is saved into SQL Account, every action is logged, and SQL Account's own rules are kept. That is what SuDu's sync tool does."

Note: say "can freeze", not "will crash". Claude is made by Anthropic and Codex by OpenAI; both logos are shown only to name the tools.
Next: "So AI needs something underneath it."
plug-straight-in.zh:
“每个星期都有人问我：我侄子，或者我的 IT 说，他这个周末就能把 ChatGPT、Claude 或 Codex 直接接到我的 SQL Account。可以吗？可以，他大概做得到。但这些地方会出问题。

第一：没有 access control。它能读每一个数字，也能改任何一个，而且不会先问你。就像第一天就把总钥匙和公司印章交给一个新来的临时工。

第二：它可能把 server 卡死。SQL Account 把资料放在数据库里。一个很重的问题，比如 5 年来的每一笔销售，就能把它锁住，整个办公室都开不了 Invoice，要等它恢复。

第三：它会把你的账搞乱。直接写进数据库，就跳过了 SQL Account 自己的检查：单号、库存更新、账目。你的记录彼此对不上，可能几个月都没发现。

所以危险的不是 AI Agent，是直接接进去。安全的做法是正规的连接：每个用户都有权限，存进 SQL Account 之前要有人批准，每个动作都有记录，SQL Account 自己的规则也照样遵守。这就是 SuDu 的同步工具在做的事。”

备注：要说“可能会卡死”，不要说“一定会当机”。Claude 是 Anthropic 做的，Codex 是 OpenAI 做的；两个标志只是用来指出是哪个工具。
下一页：“所以 AI 底下需要有东西撑着。”

problem-2.en:
"Problem two. Look at this list. Check who is overdue. Send fifteen payment reminders on WhatsApp. Match the bank slips to the invoices. Send statements. Check the stock. Put the sales report together. Somebody in your office does this every day. And tomorrow, the list starts again. None of it needs a decision. All of it needs a person, today."

Next: "Problem three is worse, because you don't see it."
problem-2.zh:
“第二个问题。看看这张清单。查看谁逾期。在 WhatsApp 发十五条付款提醒。把银行单据对上 Invoice。发对账单。检查库存。整理销售报表。你办公室里每天都有人在做这些。到了明天，清单又从头开始。这些都不需要做决定，但全部都需要一个人，今天就要做。”

下一页：“第三个问题更糟，因为你看不到它。”

problem-3.en:
"Problem three: problems you find too late. This is a sample customer. Every week, nine or ten cartons. Then the orders get smaller, and then they stop. Maybe a competitor called him. Nobody in the office notices, because nobody is watching every customer every week. Seven weeks later someone asks, whatever happened to Ah Seng? By then he is gone. Same with stock: you find out it ran out when the customer calls. Same with sales: you see the drop in the month-end report, a month after it started."

Note: sample data, say so.
Next: "Problem four: your stock figures."
problem-3.zh:
“问题三：问题发现得太迟。这是一个示例顾客。每个星期，九到十箱。然后订单越来越少，然后就停了。可能是竞争对手找上他了。办公室里没人发现，因为没有人每个星期盯着每一个顾客。七个星期后，有人问：Ah Seng 怎么了？那时候他已经走了。库存也一样：顾客打电话来，你才知道缺货了。销售也一样：要到月底报表你才看到下滑，那已经是开始下滑一个月之后了。”

备注：这是示例数据，要讲明。
下一页：“问题四：你的库存数字。”

problem-4.en:
"Problem four: stock. SQL Account says forty cartons. Somebody walks to the shelf: twelve. Where did twenty-eight go? Here is what really happens in most warehouses.

Manual picking: picking is done on paper, so the wrong item or quantity goes out and nobody updates the system. There is no fixed shelf spot, so goods are left wherever there is space and nobody records which shelf. So stock cannot be found: it is in the warehouse, but nobody knows where. The oldest stock is not sent first, so the old cartons sit at the back and expire. UOM mixed up: pieces get keyed as cartons. And everything is typed in the next day.

What does it cost? You promise stock you don't have. Expired stock is thrown out. Staff spend hours searching. And the warehouse stops for a day at every month-end count.

Hands up if your stock count never matches the system." (Pause.) "If you don't trust the number, you can't let a person, or an AI, promise stock to a customer."

Next: "And problem 5, the one that hurts the most: cash."
problem-4.zh:
“问题四：库存。SQL Account 写 40 箱。有人走去货架看：12 箱。另外 28 箱去哪里了？大部分仓库真正发生的是这样。

Manual Picking：拣货用纸，所以拿错货、拿错数量，也没人更新系统。没有固定货位，哪里有空位就放哪里，也没人记录放在哪个货架。所以货找不到：明明在仓库里，就是没人知道在哪里。最旧的货没有先出，旧箱子放在后面就过期了。UOM 混在一起：件数被打成箱数。而且什么都是隔天才输入。

代价是什么？你答应给顾客你没有的货。过期货只能丢掉。员工花好几个小时找货。每到月底盘点，仓库就要停工一天。

你的盘点从来对不上系统的，请举手。”（停顿。）“如果你不相信这个数字，你就不能让一个人，或者一个 AI，答应顾客有货。”

下一页：“还有问题 5，最痛的那个：现金。”

problem-5.en:
"Problem five: cash. The goods are delivered on day zero. The invoice is typed and sent on day three, because the office is behind. Payment is due a month later, and the customer forgets. Someone chases. The money arrives on day sixty-three, and the bank slip is sitting somewhere in a WhatsApp chat until somebody matches it. For two months, your money is in your customer's bank, and you are paying salaries and suppliers in the meantime."

Note: sample timeline; use the room's real payment terms if you know them.
Next: "So what do all five problems cost you? Let's count it, with your own numbers."

questions.en:
Take questions for about ten minutes, then the lucky draw, then the closing line (slide 33).
If the room is quiet: "Let me ask the one everybody is thinking: do I have to stop using SQL Account?"

Prepared answers:
· Stop using SQL Account? No. It stays; SuDu works around it and sends records back.
· AutoCount? Yes, it connects to AutoCount as well.
· Replace my staff? It takes over the typing and chasing. Staff check, approve and deal with customers.
· Mistakes? Important steps wait for approval, everything is recorded, every new job starts draft-only.
· Data safe / used for training? [Confirm with product team.]
· Messy data? Yes, start anyway: the readiness check, and we clean item codes during setup.
· Languages? [Confirm: BM, English, Chinese, mixed.]
· Grants? [Confirm HRD Corp and digitalisation grant position.]
questions.zh:
提问时间约 10 分钟，然后幸运抽奖，再讲结语（第 33 页）。
如果全场安静：“我来问一个大家心里都在想的问题：我是不是要停用 SQL Account？”

预备答案：
· 要停用 SQL Account 吗？不用。它照用；SuDu 在它周围运作，并把记录写回去。
· AutoCount？可以，也能连 AutoCount。
· 会取代我的员工吗？它接手打单和追款。员工负责检查、批准和应对顾客。
· 出错怎么办？重要步骤要等批准，所有东西都有记录，每个新工作都从只出草稿开始。
· 数据安全吗／会被拿去训练吗？[和产品团队确认。]
· 数据很乱？可以，照样开始：先做准备度检查，我们在设置期间帮你整理货品编号。
· 语言？[确认：马来文、英文、中文、混合。]
· 津贴？[确认 HRD Corp 和数码化津贴的情况。]

readiness-check.en:
"Worksheet, box 2. Eight questions about your own company. Be honest: nobody sees this but you and your coach. 1 point for every yes."

Then, as they work, why each one matters:
1 One code per item — it cannot tell whether two codes are the same Milo.
2 Fixed units — "10" could mean ten cartons or ten pieces.
3 System matches shelf — it will promise customers stock you do not have.
4 Orders in one place — it can only read the chats it is connected to.
5 Credit limits set — it cannot check a limit that is not there.
6 Price list up to date — it will quote last year's price.
7 Approvers written down — it needs to know who to ask.
8 Phone numbers saved — it cannot message someone it cannot find.

Do: eight minutes to answer, then five minutes to talk at the table. 1 to 3 points: foundation first; 4 to 6: start with the AI Agent; 7 or 8: ready for the whole system.
Next: "1 more check: how big does your house need to be?"
readiness-check.zh:
“作业纸，第 2 格。8 个关于你自己公司的问题。老实回答：除了你和你的教练，没人会看到。每个‘是’得 1 分。”

然后，在大家作答时，讲每一题为什么重要：
1 每个货品一个编号 — 它分不出两个编号是不是同一个 Milo。
2 单位固定 — “10” 可能是 10 箱，也可能是 10 件。
3 系统和货架对得上 — 它会答应给顾客你根本没有的货。
4 订单集中一处 — 它只能读到已连接的聊天。
5 设好信用额度 — 没有额度，它就没法检查。
6 价格表是最新的 — 它会报去年的价钱。
7 写明谁批准 — 它要知道该问谁。
8 电话已存 — 找不到人，它就没法发信息。

操作：8 分钟作答，然后各桌讨论 5 分钟。1 到 3 分：先打地基；4 到 6 分：先用 AI Agent；7 或 8 分：可以直接上整套系统。
下一页：“再做 1 个检查：你的房子要多大？”

readiness-qr.en:
"Take out your phone and scan this QR code. 8 questions about your own company. Answer honestly, it takes a few minutes. Is your data clean? Are your rules clear? Are your orders and contacts complete? When you finish, you see straight away whether your company is ready for AI."

Do: coaches help anyone who cannot scan.
Next: "Let's go through the questions 1 by 1."
readiness-qr.zh:
“请拿出手机扫这个二维码。8 个关于你自己公司的问题，老实回答，几分钟就好。你的数据干净吗？你的规则清楚吗？你的订单和联系人齐全吗？答完马上知道你的公司准备好用 AI 了没有。”

操作：教练帮忙不会扫码的人。
下一页：“我们一题一题来看。”

section-ai.en:
"So what is AI, really? Forget the headlines. We will go in 3 steps.

One: the 5 types of AI you already use every day. Two: the brain, the thing people call an LLM, and how much it read. Three: the agent, a brain that can actually do the work."

Next: "First, the 5 types of AI you already use."
section-ai.zh:
“那 AI 到底是什么？先别管新闻标题。我们分 3 步来讲。

第一：你每天都在用的 5 种 AI。第二：大脑，就是大家说的 LLM，还有它读了多少东西。第三：AI Agent，一个真的能做事的大脑。”

下一页：“首先，看看你每天都在用的 5 种 AI。”

speaker.en:
"I'm Landis, CEO and founder of SuDu AI. My background is IT and supply chain. Before SuDu, I led Industry 4.0 projects at GDEX, Top Glove and other global companies: warehouse RFID, manufacturing systems, SAP. I have spent more than five years working with SQL Account and AutoCount companies like yours, and as an HRDC certified trainer I have trained more than fifty companies.

So I know what your office looks like on a Monday morning. "

Do: under one minute.
If someone else presents, swap the photo and facts (Owen Ng, CRO: 7+ years supply chain, 2 years SAP projects, 5 years building SuDu AI).
Source: SuDu company profile, page 4.
Next: "And my co-founder, Owen."
speaker.zh:
“我是 Landis，SuDu AI 的创办人兼 CEO。我是 IT 和供应链出身。在 SuDu 之前，我在 GDEX、Top Glove 和其他跨国公司主导工业 4.0 项目：仓库 RFID、生产管理系统、SAP。我跟像你们这样用 SQL Account 和 AutoCount 的公司合作了五年多，作为 HRDC 认证讲师，也培训过五十多家公司。

所以我很清楚，你们办公室星期一早上是什么样子。”

操作：控制在一分钟以内。
如果换人主讲，换掉照片和资料（Owen Ng，CRO：7 年以上供应链经验，2 年 SAP 项目，5 年打造 SuDu AI）。
来源：SuDu 公司简介，第 4 页。
下一页：“还有我的联合创办人，Owen。”

speaker-owen.en:
"And I'm Owen, CRO and co-founder of SuDu AI. I started in supply chain, spent two years on SAP projects, and for the last five years I have been building SuDu: the warehouse system, the factory system and the AI assistant, bringing sales, purchasing, warehouse and factory work together in one system."

Do: under one minute.
Source: SuDu company profile, page 5.
Next: "Before we start, here is what we cover today."
speaker-owen.zh:
“我是 Owen，SuDu AI 的联合创办人兼 CRO。我从供应链起步，做了两年 SAP 项目，过去五年一直在打造 SuDu：仓库系统、工厂系统和 AI 助手，把销售、采购、仓库、工厂流程结合在一个系统。”

操作：控制在一分钟以内。
来源：SuDu 公司简介，第 5 页。
下一页：“开始之前，先看看我们今天的内容。”

sql-stays.en:
"You keep SQL Account. Your accounts team keeps working in it exactly as they do today. SQL Account keeps the records: it knows your customers, prices and credit terms. SuDu does the daily work using that knowledge. And every result goes back into SQL Account. This is the door of the house: SuDu connects through its own tool, with permission control. Nothing writes straight into your database."

Note: confirm with the product team exactly which documents post back to SQL Account in the version on sale.
Next: "Now the foundation."
sql-stays.zh:
“你继续用 SQL Account。你的会计团队照今天的方式在里面工作。SQL Account 保存记录：它知道你的顾客、价格和信用条件。SuDu 用这些资料做日常工作。每个结果都回到 SQL Account。这就是房子的门：SuDu 用自己的工具连接，有权限控制。没有任何东西直接写进你的数据库。”

备注：跟产品团队确认，在卖的版本里到底哪些单据会传回 SQL Account。
下一页：“现在讲地基。”

starting-point.en:
"Find your score. Low score: start with the foundation, and add the AI when your data is ready. Middle score: start with the AI agent on the data you already have, one job at a time. High score: take the whole system. Whichever you choose, it is the same system, so you never throw anything away when you add the next part."

Next: "What do you get back?"
starting-point.zh:
“找到你的分数。分数低：先打地基，等数据准备好再加 AI。分数中等：先用 AI Agent，跑你已有的数据，一次一个工作。分数高：直接上整套系统。不管选哪个，都是同一套系统，所以加下一部分时，之前做的都不会浪费。”

下一页：“你能拿回什么？”

takeaways.en:
"By the end of today, you take home 3 things.

One: a clear picture of AI. What AI really is, how an AI Agent works, what it can and cannot do, with no tech talk.

Two: you know how to plan AI for your business. Where your company should start, and which job is best to hand to AI first.

Three: a free Demo AI Account. Go back and try it yourself: watch AI Agents work on sample data."

Next: "But first, be honest: who is really the boss of your company?"
takeaways.zh:
“今天结束时，你会带走 3 样东西。

第一：提升 AI 认知。AI 到底是什么、AI Agent 怎么做事、它能做什么、不能做什么，不讲技术术语。

第二：懂得规划企业 AI 自动化。你的公司该从哪里开始，哪一份工作最适合先交给 AI。

第三：收获免费 Demo AI Account。回去就可以自己试，用示范数据看 AI Agent 做事。”

下一页：“不过先说真的：你公司真正的老板是谁？”

tell-us.en:
"Take out your phone and scan this. Three questions, one minute. Your answers will be on this screen in a few minutes. By the end of today each of you will leave with three things written on the worksheet in front of you: your number, your readiness score, and your first AI job."

Do: coaches help anyone who cannot scan. The demo driver watches the answers come in.
Form: name, company, mobile; Q1 keying in orders / chasing payments / checking stock / typing up paper forms / making reports; Q2 1 person / 2 to 3 / 4 or more; Q3 (stock and finance figures) fully / mostly / not much; consent line.
Next: "While the answers come in, here are the five problems we hear most."
tell-us.zh:
“请拿出手机扫一下这个。三个问题，一分钟。几分钟后，你们的答案就会出现在这个屏幕上。今天结束时，每个人都会带着写在面前作业纸上的三样东西离开：你的数字、你的准备度分数，还有你的第一个 AI 工作。”

操作：教练帮忙不会扫码的人。演示操作员留意答案进来。
表格：姓名、公司、手机；Q1 输入订单 / 追款 / 查库存 / 把纸本表格打进电脑 / 做报表；Q2 1 个人 / 2 到 3 个 / 4 个或以上；Q3（库存和财务数据）完全信任 / 大部分信任 / 不太信任；同意声明。
下一页：“答案进来的同时，先看看我们最常听到的五个问题。”

the-house.en:
"AI is like a house. Most people only look at the roof. The AI is the exciting part. But a roof needs a house under it, and AI on messy data only makes mistakes faster. So build from the foundation up. For each level, 1 risk and 1 question to check yourself.

1, the foundation: clean data. 1 code per item, fixed units, and stock that matches the shelf because every carton is scanned and every job recorded. Without it, the AI quotes the wrong price and promises stock you do not have. Check: when you count, does the system match the shelf?

2, the door: a safe connection. The AI goes through a controlled door that keeps your accounting rules, never straight into the database. Without it, 1 wrong command can freeze the server or break your accounts. Check: does any tool write straight into your SQL database?

3, the walls: permissions and approvals. Who may see what, do what, and say yes, with every action logged. Without them, the AI can change anything, and nobody knows who did what. Check: is it written down who approves discounts, credit and purchases?

4, the roof: the AI Agents doing the daily work. Without them, people keep typing and chasing by hand. Check: which job eats the most hours each week?

For the next part, I will show you the whole house, working."

The house builds itself from the ground up; the numbered dots match the 4 levels. This is thread 2; it returns later in the deck.
Next: "Before the demo, 1 picture every admin in this room will understand."
the-house.zh:
“AI 就像一栋房子。大多数人只看屋顶。AI 是最吸引人的部分。但屋顶下面要有房子，数据乱，AI 只会更快出错。所以要从地基盖起。每一层，我讲 1 个风险，再给你 1 个问题自己检查。

1，地基：干净的数据。每样货 1 个编号、单位固定、库存和货架对得上，因为每一箱都扫描、每张工单都有记录。没有它，AI 会报错价格，答应给你没有的货。检查：盘点时，系统和货架对得上吗？

2，门：安全的连接。AI 走一道受控的门，守住你的会计规则，绝不直接进数据库。没有它，1 个错误指令就能卡死服务器，或把你的账搞乱。检查：有没有工具直接写进你的 SQL 数据库？

3，墙：权限与批准。谁能看什么、做什么、批准什么，每个动作都有记录。没有它，AI 什么都能改，也没人知道谁做了什么。检查：谁批准折扣、信用额度和采购，有没有写下来？

4，屋顶：AI Agent 做日常工作。没有它，员工继续人手打单、人手追。检查：哪份工作每周最花时间？

接下来，我让你们看整栋房子运作起来。”

房子会从地面自己盖起来；编号圆点对应 4 层。这是第 2 条主线，后面还会再出现。
下一页：“演示之前，先给大家看 1 张图，在座每一位 Admin 都会懂。”

the-map.en:
"First, the big picture, in plain words.

The big box is SuDu: one ERP, one system, one database. Inside it the work flows left to right. Supply chain: selling and buying, so orders are in one place. The warehouse, WMS: every carton is scanned, so stock is accurate. The factory, MES: every job is tracked, so you can see every job. And finance: everything goes into SQL Account, so your accounts are always up to date.

On the left, customers and suppliers reach the system the way they already work: WhatsApp and email. Across the top, the AI agents read everything and do the work at every step. At the bottom, the next step: physical AI, an auto-driving truck and a humanoid robot, run by the same system.

Watch one order travel through it." (It loops by itself, about 17 seconds.)

Note: physical AI is the roadmap, not on sale today.
Next: "Every company is walking the same road. Where is yours?"
the-map.zh:
“先看全貌，用大白话讲。

这个大框就是 SuDu：1 个 ERP，1 个系统，1 个数据库。里面的工作从左流到右。供应链：卖和买，所以订单都在同一个地方。仓库，WMS：每一箱都扫描，所以库存准确。工厂，MES：每张工单都追踪，所以每张工单你都看得到。还有财务：所有东西都进到 SQL Account，所以你的账永远是最新的。

左边，顾客和供应商照他们本来的方式联系你：WhatsApp 和 Email。上面一排，AI Agent 读取所有资料，在每一步做事。最下面是下一步：实体 AI，一辆自动驾驶货车和一个人形机器人，由同一个系统来管。

看一张订单怎么走完全程。”（它会自己循环播放，大约 17 秒。）

备注：实体 AI 是路线图，今天还没有在卖。
下一页：“每家公司都在走同一条路。你的公司走到哪里了？”

today.en:
"Here is what we cover today, in 5 parts.

Part 1, what is an AI Agent: how an LLM really works, why people invented the AI Agent, and what it needs to work in a real company. Part 2, the problems businesses face: the 5 problems we see in almost every office, and what they cost you. You will work out your own company's cost. Part 3, SuDu AI: the system, and then 6 AI Agents doing real jobs live on the screen, sales, stock, buying, payments and finance. Part 4, the workshop: you score your own company, check if you need a WMS or MES, and write your first AI job. Part 5, get started: where your company should start, what it saves you, and your next step."

Next: "So what do you take home today?"
today.zh:
“这是我们今天的内容，分 5 部分。

第 1 部分，什么是 AI Agent：LLM 到底怎么运作、为什么会有 AI Agent，以及它在真实公司里需要什么才能做事。第 2 部分，企业面临的问题：几乎每间办公室都有的 5 个问题，以及它们让你花了多少钱。你会算出你的公司 costing。第 3 部分，SuDu AI：先看系统，再看 6 个 AI Agent 在屏幕上现场做真实的工作，销售、库存、采购、收款和财务。第 4 部分，Workshop：你给自己的公司打分，看看需不需要 WMS 或 MES，然后写下你的第一个 AI 工作。第 5 部分，正式启动：你的公司该从哪里开始、能帮你省多少，以及你的下一步。”

下一页：“那今天你会收获什么？”

tokens.en:
"One more thing about how it reads. It does not read words. It cuts your message into small pieces, called tokens. Watch." (let the pieces appear) "Pls arrange delivery be4 12pm, bwg besar 10 kg times 20. 9 words, 16 tokens. Common English words are 1 piece. Short forms like be4, and Malay words like bwg, get cut into smaller pieces. Rule of thumb: 1 token is about three quarters of an English word."

(Next) "Step 2: each piece becomes a number. Pls is 3427, arrange is 31408. The brain never sees letters, only numbers. Think of stock codes: every piece has its own code, and the brain works with the codes."

(Next) "Step 3: the same meaning can cost a different number of tokens. Please deliver tomorrow: 3 tokens in English. Tolong hantar esok: about 6. In Chinese, about 4. And short forms like pls del tmr be4 12 cost the most, because the model rarely saw them. English is usually the cheapest."

(Next) "So why should you care? 3 reasons. 1: you pay per token, in and out, like a phone bill. A WhatsApp order is about 30 tokens; a 10-page PDF is about 6,500. 2: it can only hold so much at once. AI people call this the context window: the size of its desk. Big models today hold about 1 million tokens, about 7 books. But in a very long chat, the early details still start to slip, so a good AI system looks up the fact it needs, fresh, each time. 3: it writes 1 token at a time; a fast model writes about 100 a second, so a long answer takes a few seconds."

This slide has 3 extra Next presses.
Note: token counts and code numbers are illustrations; each model cuts text differently. 1 million tokens: DeepSeek V4 (Hugging Face). Speeds vary by model.
Next: "And how does it know what those pieces mean?"
tokens.zh:
“再讲一件关于它怎么读的事。它不是一个字一个字读，而是把你的信息切成小块，叫做 Token。看。”（让小块出现）“Pls arrange delivery be4 12pm, bwg besar 10 kg x 20。9 个词，16 个 Token。常见的英文单词是 1 块。像 be4 这种简写，还有 bwg 这种马来文，会被切成更小的块。粗略记法：1 个 Token 大约是 ¾ 个英文单词。”

（下一步）“第 2 步：每一块变成一个号码。Pls 是 3427，arrange 是 31408。大脑从来不看字母，只看号码。就像货品编号：每一块都有自己的编号，大脑用的是这些编号。”

（下一步）“第 3 步：同样的意思，Token 数可以不一样。Please deliver tomorrow：英文 3 个 Token。Tolong hantar esok：大约 6 个。中文大约 4 个。像 pls del tmr be4 12 这种简写最贵，因为模型很少看过。英文通常最便宜。”

（下一步）“那为什么跟你有关？3 个原因。第一：你按 Token 付钱，进和出都算，像电话账单。1 张 WhatsApp 订单大约 30 个 Token；10 页的 PDF 大约 6,500 个。第二：它一次能装的有限。AI 圈叫这个 Context Window：它桌子的大小。今天的大模型大约能装 100 万个 Token，大概 7 本书。但聊天很长的时候，前面的细节还是会开始漏掉，所以好的 AI 系统每次都重新去查它需要的资料。第三：它一次写 1 个 Token；快的模型每秒大约写 100 个，所以长的回答要几秒钟。”

这一页有 3 次额外的下一步。
备注：Token 数和编号只是示意；每个模型切法不同。100 万 Token：DeepSeek V4（Hugging Face）。速度因模型而异。
下一页：“那它怎么知道这些小块是什么意思？”

tools-and-memory.en:
"Here is the part people forget. The smartest brain in the world, with no tools, can only talk. The brain understands and plans. The tools are its hands: check stock, create an order, send a message. And every tool works inside 1 place: your ERP, where your customers, stock, orders and money live."

(Next) "And here is the catch. Every tool is a button inside your ERP. Look at the left: many companies run on a paper notebook, Excel on 3 different PCs, WhatsApp chats, and things only the boss remembers. Give an AI Agent that company, and what can it do? Nothing to check, nothing to click. It can only guess, and a guess is dangerous. On the right is SuDu: 1 place for all your data, SQL Account, warehouse and factory, and every job has a real button: check stock, create the Sales Order, send the DO, record the payment. Now the agent can do the work. So remember: an AI Agent is only as good as the system it works in. That is why SuDu comes first."

This slide has 1 extra Next press: why tools need a proper ERP.
Next: "Let me show you what that looks like in a real warehouse."
tools-and-memory.zh:
“这是大家最容易忘记的部分。世界上最聪明的大脑，没有工具，也只能讲话。大脑负责看懂和计划。工具是它的双手：查库存、开订单、发信息。而每个工具都在 1 个地方运作：你的 ERP，你的客户、库存、订单和钱都在那里。”

（下一步）“关键在这里。每个工具都是你 ERP 里的一个按钮。看左边：很多公司靠一本纸本簿子、3 台不同电脑里的 Excel、WhatsApp 聊天记录，还有只有老板记得的东西在运作。把 AI Agent 放进这样的公司，它能做什么？没东西可查，没东西可按。它只能猜，而猜是很危险的。右边是 SuDu：所有数据都在 1 个地方，SQL Account、仓库和工厂，每份工作都有真正的按钮：查库存、开 Sales Order、发 DO、记录收款。这样 AI Agent 才能做事。所以记住：AI Agent 有多好，要看它所在的系统有多好。这就是为什么 SuDu 要先到位。”

这一页多按 1 次 Next：为什么工具需要好的 ERP。
下一页：“我来给你看看，在真正的仓库里是什么样子。”

top-5-issues.en:
"While your answers come in, here are the five problems we hear in almost every company we visit.

One: orders typed in by hand. Every WhatsApp and email order is keyed in again, and it takes a team of people to do it.

Two: routine work done by people. Chasing overdue payments, sending statements, checking the same reports every morning.

Three: problems found too late. Sales drop, a good customer stops ordering, stock runs out, and nobody notices until it hurts.

Four: stock that is never right. The system says forty cartons, the shelf has twelve.

And five: cash comes in late. The invoice goes out days after the delivery, and the bank slip is lost somewhere in the chat.

Put your hand up if you have at least three of these." (Pause.)

Do: let the hands go up; it is the same point the poll will make with data.
Note: issue 5 is our suggestion; swap it for the room's top answer if the poll shows something else.
Next: "Let me show you how problem number one starts."
top-5-issues.zh:
“大家的答案还在进来，我先讲我们几乎每家公司都会听到的 5 个问题。

第一：订单靠人手输入。每张 WhatsApp 和 Email 订单都要再打一次，要一整队人来做。

第二：日常工作靠人做。追逾期款、发对账单、每天早上看同样的报表。

第三：问题发现太迟。销售下跌、好顾客不再下单、库存断货，等到痛了才有人发现。

第四：库存永远不准。系统写 40 箱，货架上只有 12 箱。

第五：钱收得慢。送货后好几天才发 Invoice，银行单据还不知道丢在哪个聊天里。

这 5 个里面中了至少 3 个的，请举手。”（停顿。）

操作：让大家举手；这跟投票用数据要讲的是同一个重点。
备注：问题 5 是我们的建议；如果投票结果显示别的，换成现场最多人选的答案。
下一页：“我让你们看看问题一是怎么开始的。”

typed-three-times.en:
"Follow one order once it is decoded. It comes in by WhatsApp, PDF or a phone call, about 80 a day in a typical distributor. Then a person keys it into SQL Account: new sales order, customer, then line by line, field by field: item code, quantity, unit, price. About 4 minutes an order.

Then the store needs a picking list. The order is already in SQL Account, but in many companies someone types it again into Excel: item, quantity, which rack. Print, pick, pack. Another 2 minutes.

Add it up: 80 orders times 6 minutes is 8 hours a day. That is 1 full-time person who only types. And because the same order is typed twice, there are 2 chances for a wrong code or 10 pieces read as 10 cartons.

Your books are right; SQL Account does its job. The trouble is all the typing around the books. It is nobody's fault; it is how the work was set up."

Do: point at each card as you say it. Note: 80 orders, 4 and 2 minutes are an example; ask the room for theirs.
Next: "Problem two: the routine work."
typed-three-times.zh:
“跟着一张破解好的订单走一遍。它从 WhatsApp、PDF 或电话进来，一般的批发商每天大约 80 张。然后有人把它输入 SQL Account：新开 Sales Order、选顾客，然后一行一行、一栏一栏：货品编号、数量、单位、价格。每张大约 4 分钟。

然后仓库需要 Picking List。订单已经在 SQL Account 里了，但很多公司还是有人把它再打一次进 Excel：货品、数量、哪个货架。打印、拣货、打包。又是 2 分钟。

加起来：80 张订单乘 6 分钟，就是每天 8 小时。等于 1 个全职员工只在打字。而且同一张订单打了两次，就有 2 次机会打错编号，或者把 10 件看成 10 箱。

你的账是对的；SQL Account 做好了它的工作。问题出在账目周围所有的打字工作。这不是谁的错，是工作本来就是这样安排的。”

操作：讲到每张卡时就指着它。备注：80 张订单、4 分钟和 2 分钟只是例子；问问现场观众他们的数字。
下一页：“第二个问题：日常工作。”

vision.en:
(Let the line land. Pause for two seconds before speaking.)

"Our vision at SuDu is to build an AI that runs a company on its own. Not a chatbot. Not a report. An AI that runs the operation. Look at the sphere: every point is a job in your company. Order, buy, receive, store, make, ship, bill, collect, and all the jobs around them: quote, credit check, pick, pack, count, plan, quality check, pay the supplier, report. Every one is connected, and the work keeps moving around it on its own.

That is why SuDu is the AI ERP built for this, to serve businesses: 1 system runs every process, AI executes, analyses and reminds, and people make the decisions. Most software adds AI on top: a chatbot sits beside the old system, and people still key in, click and chase. We built the system itself for AI, so it can read every order, every stock count and every payment, decide, and do the work, with people approving what matters. And the last step is physical: robots that move, pick and count, run by the same system.

That is where we are going. Let me show you what it looks like today."

Next: the map.
vision.zh:
（让这句话停留一下。先停两秒再开口。）

“SuDu 的愿景，是打造一个能自动化运营公司的 AI。不是聊天机器人，不是报表，而是一个运营公司的 AI。看这个球体：每一个点都是你公司里的一项工作。接单、采购、收货、存货、生产、出货、开单、收款，还有围绕它们的所有工作：报价、信用检查、拣货、打包、盘点、计划、品质检查、付款给供应商、做报表。每一项都连在一起，工作在上面自己不停地运转。

这就是为什么 SuDu 是为此服务企业的 AI ERP：1 个系统管理所有流程，AI 负责执行、分析、提醒，人类负责决策。大部分软件只是在上面加 AI：旧系统旁边放一个聊天机器人，人还是要输入、点击、追。我们是为 AI 打造整个系统，所以它能读取每张订单、每次盘点、每笔付款，做决策、做事，重要的事由人来批准。最后一步是实体的：由同一个系统驱动的机器人，负责搬运、拣货和盘点。

这就是我们的方向。现在让我给大家看看它今天的样子。”
