what-is-agent.en:
"A brain alone only talks. So, step by step, people gave it more: tools in 2023, and from 2025 agents that work on their own. If the LLM is the brain, an AI agent is the brain with hands, and with limits. Here it is as a robot with 5 parts. A brain alone only talks; it tells you what to do. Give it the other 4 parts and it does the work for you. Let me take them 1 at a time."

(Next) Brain: "The head is the language model. It understands the message and plans the next step. It understands meaning, not keywords: bwg, bawang and onion are the same thing. Here it reads big onions, 10 kg bags, and sees the quantity is missing, so it asks. But on its own it has never seen your company. Like a smart graduate on day 1."

(Next) Tools: "The hands, and the part people forget. Each tool is 1 action in a real system. Some tools only look: check stock, read an invoice. Some tools act: create an order, send a message. The brain cannot click a button. Without tools, it can only tell you what to do. No tools, no work."

(Next) Memory: "The filing cabinet in its chest. Most people do not know this: the brain forgets everything after each chat. So it looks things up in your records: customers, prices, stock, fresh every time. Jaya Grocer's last price for big onions: RM28 a bag. Which also means: messy records in, wrong answers out."

(Next) Rules and skills: "The rulebook in its hand. Your way of working, written down. Rules say what must never happen: over the credit limit, stop and ask the boss. Skills are the steps for 1 job: read the order, match the items, check stock, draft, send for approval. Plain words, so your manager can read and change them."

(Next) Permission: "The badge on its chest, and what makes it safe. What can it see? Only the data its job needs. What can it do? Only what you allow: draft yes, delete no, move money never. And anything important waits for a person, and every action is logged. This is the difference between a helper and a risk."

(Next) "Put the 5 together on 1 WhatsApp order: the brain reads it, memory finds the customer and the stock, the tools draft the order in your ERP, the rules make it ask when an item is unclear, and permission means you approve before anything is saved."

This slide has 6 extra Next presses: the 5 parts, then 1 order.
Next: "But not every agent is a good agent. Meet 2 of them."
what-is-agent.zh:
“大脑单靠自己只会讲。所以，大家一步一步给它加东西：2023 年加上工具，2025 年开始有能自己做事的 AI Agent。如果 LLM 是大脑，那 AI Agent 就是有双手、也有限制的大脑。这里把它画成一个机器人，有 5 个部分。大脑单靠自己只会讲；它只能教你怎么做。把另外 4 个部分给它，它就帮你把事做完。我们一个一个来看。”

（下一步）大脑：“头部就是语言模型。它看懂信息，计划下一步。它懂的是意思，不是关键词：bwg、bawang、onion 都是同一样东西。这里它读出是大洋葱、10 kg 装，也发现没写数量，所以它会问。但单靠它自己，它从来没见过你的公司。就像第 1 天上班、很聪明的毕业生。”

（下一步）工具：“双手，也是大家最容易忘记的部分。每个工具是真实系统里的 1 个动作。有些工具只是看：查库存、读 Invoice。有些工具会动手：开订单、发信息。大脑自己按不了按钮。没有工具，它只能教你怎么做。没有工具，就做不了事。”

（下一步）记忆：“胸口里的档案柜。大部分人不知道：每次聊完，大脑就什么都忘了。所以它要去你的记录里查：顾客、价格、库存，每次都查最新的。Jaya Grocer 上次的大洋葱价：每包 RM28。这也代表：记录乱，答案就错。”

（下一步）规则与技能：“它手上的规则本。把你的做法写下来。规则讲的是什么绝对不能发生：超过信用额度，就停下来问老板。技能是做 1 件工作的步骤：读订单、对货品、查库存、起草、送去批准。用白话写，你的经理也能看、也能改。”

（下一步）权限：“胸前的工作证，也是让它安全的关键。它能看什么？只看它工作需要的资料。它能做什么？只做你允许的：起草可以，删除不行，动钱绝对不行。重要的事都要等人来定，而且每个动作都有记录。帮手和风险的分别，就在这里。”

（下一步）“把 5 个部分放在 1 张 WhatsApp 订单上：大脑读订单，记忆找出顾客和库存，工具在你的 ERP 起草订单，规则让它在货品不清楚时开口问，权限就是你批准了才会保存。”

这一页多按 6 次 Next：5 个部分，再看 1 张订单。
下一页：“但不是每个 AI Agent 都是好 AI Agent。来认识 2 位。”

what-is-llm.en:
"ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek. You know the names. Inside each one is the same kind of thing: an LLM, a large language model. Large, because it read a huge amount of text. Language, because words go in and words come out.

What does it actually do? Only 1 thing. Let's try. Terima kasih, see you..." (pause, let the room finish) "...tomorrow. You did it too. It looked at the words so far and picked the most likely next word. Then the next. Then the next. Done well enough, that looks like understanding.

Remember this sentence: it does not look answers up. It predicts them, 1 word at a time. Everything else today follows from that."

(Next) "1 small correction: it does not really see words. Think of LEGO: it breaks your message into small bricks called tokens, then builds the reply 1 brick at a time. A token is a small piece of text: a word, part of a word, or a comma. Terima kasih, see you tomorrow becomes 8 pieces: Ter, ima, kas, ih, comma, see, you, tomorrow. Short English words are 1 token; Malay words often become 2 or 3. Rule of thumb: 1 token is about three quarters of an English word. Why care? Because AI is measured in tokens: you pay per token, and its memory is counted in tokens. So when people say it predicts the next word, it really predicts the next token."

This slide has 1 extra Next press.
Note: the split is an illustration; each model cuts text a little differently.
Next: "To predict that well, it had to read. A lot."
what-is-llm.zh:
“ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek。这些名字大家都知道。每一个里面都是同一种东西：一个 LLM，大语言模型。叫“大”，因为它读了超级多的文字。叫“语言”，因为进去的是文字，出来的也是文字。

它到底在做什么？只做 1 件事。我们来试试。Terima kasih, see you……”（停一下，让大家接下去）“……tomorrow。你们也做到了。它看着前面的字，挑出最有可能的下一个词。然后再下一个，再下一个。做得够好，看起来就像听得懂。

记住这句话：它不是去查答案。它是 1 个词 1 个词预测出来的。今天后面讲的所有东西，都是从这里来的。”

（下一步）“小小更正一下：它其实不是看词。就像玩 LEGO：它把你的信息拆成一块块小积木，叫做 Token，然后一次加 1 块来写回答。Token 就是一小块文字：一个词、半个词，或一个逗号。Terima kasih, see you tomorrow 会变成 8 块：Ter、ima、kas、ih、逗号、see、you、tomorrow。短的英文单词是 1 个 Token；马来文常常变成 2 到 3 个。粗略记法：1 个 Token 大约是 ¾ 个英文单词。为什么要知道？因为 AI 是用 Token 来计算的：你按 Token 付钱，它的记忆也用 Token 来算。所以大家说它预测下一个词，其实它预测的是下一个 Token。”

这一页有 1 次额外的下一步。
备注：切法只是示意；每个模型切法有点不同。
下一页：“要预测得这么准，它得读书。读很多很多。”

what-it-gives-back.en:
"First, the cost of manual work. Take a wholesaler with about 80 orders a day. Sales: 3 people key in orders and reply to customers, 519 hours a month, costing RM10,350. Finance: 2 people do invoices, chase payments and reconcile, 346 hours, RM7,820. Purchasing: 1 person does POs, chases deliveries and keys in supplier invoices, RM3,680. Stock: 1 person checks stock and makes reports, RM3,706.

Added up: 7 people, 1,211 hours a month, costing RM25,556. That is RM306,672 a year, spent on the same manual work. Now look at the staff cost you worked out yourself, and compare."

Note: this is an estimate; monthly cost includes EPF and SOCSO. Say "estimate" out loud.
Next: "And with AI?"
what-it-gives-back.zh:
“我们先算人手成本。以一家每天约 80 张订单的批发商为例。Sales：3 个人输入订单、回复顾客，每月 519 小时，成本 RM10,350。Finance：2 个人开 Invoice、追款、对账，346 小时，RM7,820。采购：1 个人开 PO、追货、输入 Supplier 发票，RM3,680。库存：1 个人查库存、做报表，RM3,706。

加起来：7 个人，每月 1,211 小时，成本 RM25,556。一年就是 RM306,672，花在同样的人手工作上。现在看看你自己算的人工 costing，跟这个比一比。”

备注：这是估算，每月成本含 EPF、SOCSO；要大声说“估算”。
下一页：“那用 AI 呢？”

what-it-read.en:
"So what exactly did it read? Public text. Billions of public websites, books from novels to accounting, news and Wikipedia. In many languages: English, Malay, Chinese, Tamil and 100 more. That is why it understands rojak: boss, 3 karton milo, hantar esok.

Now the important part. (point at the right column) What did it never see? Your customers and their special prices. Your stock and your accounts in SQL Account. Your WhatsApp chats. Your SOP: who approves what, who always pays late. And nothing that happened after its training stopped.

So how do you make it useful for your company? Many people think you must retrain the brain with your data. You do not; that is slow and expensive. Instead, you let it look things up: each time it needs a fact about your company, it fetches it, then answers. Remember that, because that is exactly what an agent does."

Next: "One more thing about how it reads. It does not read whole words. It reads in small pieces."
what-it-read.zh:
“那它到底读了什么？公开的文字。几十亿个公开网站，从小说到会计的各种书，新闻和维基百科。很多种语言：英文、马来文、中文、淡米尔文，还有 100 多种。所以它听得懂 rojak：boss, 3 karton milo, hantar esok。

现在讲重点。（指着右边那一栏）它从来没见过什么？你的客户和他们的特别价格。你在 SQL Account 里的库存和账。你的 WhatsApp 聊天。你的 SOP：谁批准什么，谁总是迟付款。还有它训练结束之后发生的任何事情。

那怎样让它对你的公司有用？很多人以为一定要用你的数据重新训练这个大脑。不用；那又慢又贵。你要做的是让它去查：每次它需要你公司的某个资料，它就去拿，然后再回答。记住这一点，因为这正是 AI Agent 在做的事。”

下一页：“关于它怎么读，还有一件事。它不是一整个词一整个词地读，而是一小块一小块地读。”

who-we-are.en:
"Hello everyone. A little about SuDu AI before we start.

SuDu means two things. In Chinese, 速度 means speed: fast to set up, fast results. In Malay, sudu means spoon: easy enough to spoon-feed.

We started in 2021 by building the warehouse and factory systems, and refined them for two years. In 2022 we started building the AI. In 2023 we launched in Malaysia, in 2025 we went to Singapore and China, and this year the AI went live. Today more than 100 companies run their warehouse or factory on SuDu, and we have users in 6 countries.

Companies like Petronas, BHPetrol, YTL Hotels and Twin Arrow run on SuDu. We are certified by MDEC and HRD Corp, and we are an official SQL Account partner."

Do: keep it under two minutes.
Source: SuDu company profile, pages 1 to 3.
Next: "And here is who you will be listening to today."
who-we-are.zh:
“大家好。开始之前，先简单介绍一下 SuDu AI。

SuDu 有两个意思。中文的“速度”，就是快：上线快，见效快。马来文的 sudu 是汤匙：简单到可以一口一口喂给你。

我们 2021 年开始，先打造仓库和工厂系统，花了两年打磨。2022 年开始研发 AI。2023 年在马来西亚推出，2025 年进入新加坡和中国，今年 AI 正式上线。今天有超过 100 家公司用 SuDu 来管仓库或工厂，用户遍布 6 个国家。

Petronas、BHPetrol、YTL Hotels 和 Twin Arrow 这些公司都在用 SuDu。我们获得 MDEC 和 HRD Corp 认证，也是 SQL Account 的官方合作伙伴。”

操作：控制在两分钟以内。
来源：SuDu 公司简介，第 1 至 3 页。
下一页：“接下来介绍今天的主讲人。”

why-agents.en:
"So here is the honest picture. An LLM on its own is a brilliant talker. It can only talk. So people added 6 things around it, 1 gap at a time.

[Point along the row] 1: tools, hands to click, send and save in real systems. 2: look-up, because its knowledge stops at a cut-off date, so it fetches fresh facts every time. 3: memory, because it forgets after every chat, so notes are kept outside the brain. 4: a loop, so it does not answer in 1 shot; it tries, checks, and tries again until done. 5: rules, your SOP written down, because it does not know how your company works. 6: permission, limits plus a person who approves, so nothing stops it doing the wrong thing.

The history is short. 2022: ChatGPT, it talks. 2023: tools, it can call a system. 2025: agents, it works in a loop until the job is done.

LLM plus these 6 things: that is an AI Agent. Not a smarter brain. The same brain, with hands, memory, a loop and limits."

Note: 2022 = ChatGPT launch; 2023 = tool calling; 2025 = agents like Claude Code and Codex working on their own.
Next: "So let me show you what an AI Agent looks like."
why-agents.zh:
“老实说，情况是这样的。LLM 单靠自己，是个很会讲话的高手。但它只会讲。所以人们在它周围加了 6 样东西，一次补 1 个缺口。

[沿着这一排指过去] 第 1：工具，就是双手，在真实系统里点击、发送、保存。第 2：查资料，因为它的知识停在某个截止日期，所以它每次都去拿最新的资料。第 3：记忆，因为每次聊完它就忘了，所以笔记要放在大脑外面。第 4：循环，它不是一次就给答案；它会试、检查、再试，直到做完。第 5：规则，就是把你的 SOP 写下来，因为它不知道你公司是怎么做事的。第 6：权限，也就是限制，加上一个负责批准的人，不然没有东西能拦住它做错事。

历史其实很短。2022 年：ChatGPT，它会讲话。2023 年：工具，它能调用系统。2025 年：AI Agent，它会循环做事，直到把工作做完。

LLM 加上这 6 样东西，就是 AI Agent。不是更聪明的大脑。是同一个大脑，加上双手、记忆、循环和限制。”

备注：2022 = ChatGPT 推出；2023 = 工具调用；2025 = Claude Code、Codex 这类 AI Agent 能自己做事。
下一页：“那我给大家看看，AI Agent 长什么样。”

why-sudu.en:
"(The question fills the screen. Let it sit.) Here is the question I hear most: I already have SQL Account, why do I need SuDu?" (Next: the answer appears.) "Good question, because SQL Account is excellent. Think of your company in layers.

Layer one, the foundation, is accounting. SQL Account keeps your accounts: invoices, payments, tax, reports. But notice: it records what has already happened.

Layer two is the warehouse. A warehouse system runs the floor: every carton is scanned when it arrives, goes on a shelf, is picked and is shipped. The stock moves are recorded the moment they happen, so your stock figure is real and accurate.

Layer three, if you manufacture, is the factory: MES, a manufacturing execution system. It plans each job, issues materials against the BOM, and records output, scrap and machine time as they happen. So at any moment you can see where every job is, whether it is late, and what it really cost. No more waiting for the paper logsheet tomorrow. You can see every job.

And layer four sits on top: the AI agents. They read all three layers and do the work: take orders, buy stock, chase payments, spot problems early, and people approve. SQL Account tells you what already happened. SuDu runs what happens next."

Next: "So can I just connect ChatGPT or Claude to SQL Account myself? Here is a question I get every week."
why-sudu.zh:
（问题占满整个画面，让它停一下。）“我最常听到的问题是：我已经有 SQL Account 了，为什么还需要 SuDu？”（下一步：答案出现。）“问得好，因为 SQL Account 本身很好。我们把公司想成一层一层的。

第一层，地基，是会计。SQL Account 管你的账：Invoice、付款、税务、报表。但请注意：它记录的是已经发生的事。

第二层是仓库。仓库系统管现场：每一箱货到了就扫描，上架、拣货、出货。库存一动就马上记录，所以你的库存数字是真实、准确的。

第三层，如果你有生产，就是工厂：MES，生产执行系统。它安排每张工单，按 BOM 发料，实时记录产量、废料和机器时间。所以任何时候你都看得到每张工单做到哪里、有没有延误、实际成本多少。不用再等明天的纸本记录表。每张工单你都看得到。

第四层在最上面：AI Agent。它们读取这三层的所有数据，然后动手做事：接单、采购、追款、提早发现问题，由人来批准。SQL Account 告诉你已经发生了什么。SuDu 负责接下来要发生的事。”

下一页：“那我可以自己把 ChatGPT 或 Claude 直接接到 SQL Account 吗？这是我每个星期都会被问到的问题。”

you-stay-the-boss.en:
"You just saw it do a lot. So let me tell you the 4 things AI never does. It does not save anything you have not approved. It never changes your financial figures. It only reads the WhatsApp groups you allow. And every single thing it did is recorded, so you can check it any time. You are still the boss. Now, would this work in your company? Let's find out."

Next: "Would this work in your company? Let's score it."
you-stay-the-boss.zh:
“你们刚才看到它做了很多事。那我来讲讲 AI 绝不做的 4 件事。你没批准的东西，它什么都不会存进去。它绝不改动财务数据。它只读你允许的 WhatsApp 群组。而且它做的每一件事都有记录，你可以随时查。你还是老板。那么，这套在你公司行得通吗？我们来看看。”

下一页：“这套在你公司行得通吗？我们来打分。”

your-score.en:
"There is no bad score. It only tells you which step comes first. Zero to three: your foundation needs work before any AI will help you, and I would rather tell you that today than sell you a roof. Four to six, which is most companies: you can start with one AI job right now, on the data you already have in SQL Account. Seven or eight: you are ready for the whole house."

Do: table hosts note each company's score on their lead sheet.
Next: "1 more check: how big does your house need to be?"
your-score.zh:
“分数没有好坏，它只告诉你哪一步先做。0 到 3 分：你的地基要先打好，任何 AI 才帮得上你。我宁愿今天老实跟你讲，也不要卖你一个屋顶。4 到 6 分，大部分公司都在这里：你现在就可以开始做 1 个 AI 工作，用你在 SQL Account 里已有的数据。7 或 8 分：你已经准备好整栋房子了。”

操作：桌长把每家公司的分数记在 lead sheet 上。
下一页：“再做 1 个检查：你的房子要多大？”

ai-types.en:
"Before we open up the brain, 1 quick map. People say AI as if it is 1 thing. It is not. Sort it by what it does and you get 5 types. You already use most of them every day. Let me show you where."

(Next) Predictive AI, built on machine learning: "Think of a weather forecast, but for your sales. When Grab tells you the driver arrives in 4 minutes, or your bank sends a fraud alert, or Shopee picks products for you, that is predictive AI. It learns from past numbers and guesses the next one: here, December, 1,240 cartons. In your company: who will pay late, what will run out. Its limit: a new product has no history."

(Next) Vision AI, built on deep learning: "You see this every day at the car park. The car rolls up, the camera reads WXY 1234, checks the season pass, and the barrier lifts. No ticket, no guard. Face unlock and Google Lens work the same way. In your company: reading a handwritten order or a bank slip. Dirty plate, bad light: it can misread."

(Next) Voice AI: "Hey Siri, YouTube captions, talking to your car. It turns sound into text. Your customer sends a voice note: Boss, esok hantar 10 carton Milo. It types it out, and it becomes an order line. A noisy shop or heavy slang, and it mishears sometimes."

(Next) Diffusion AI, built on a diffusion model: "Have you watched those AI short dramas on TikTok or YouTube? Many of them were never filmed. You type 1 line: the boss finds out his clerk is an AI. It starts from pure noise, like TV static, and cleans it a little at every step. Step 25, you can see a city. Step 50, done: episode 1. Midjourney and Sora work the same way. In your company: product photos and promo videos, without a studio. Hands, faces and words can still come out wrong, so check before you post."

(Next) AI Agent, the LLM plus tools: "This one does the work. 1 WhatsApp order: it reads it, checks the stock in SQL Account, drafts the Sales Order, and then waits for you. An agent uses the other 4 as its eyes, ears and voice. That is what today is about."

This slide has 5 extra Next presses; each card flies in, in 3D, and plays its own short scene.
Next: "The brain behind ChatGPT and every AI agent is the LLM. Let's open it up."
ai-types.zh:
“在打开大脑之前，先看 1 张小地图。大家讲 AI，好像它只是 1 样东西。其实不是。按它做什么来分，有 5 种。大部分你每天都在用。我带你看看在哪里。”

（下一步）预测型 AI，背后是机器学习：“想成天气预报，只是预报你的销售。Grab 说司机 4 分钟到，银行发盗刷提醒，Shopee 帮你推荐商品，这些都是预测型 AI。它从过去的数字学习，猜出下一个：这里是 12 月，1,240 箱。在你公司：谁会迟付款，什么货快没了。它的限制：新产品没有历史数据。”

（下一步）视觉 AI，背后是深度学习：“停车场你天天见。车开到闸口，摄像头读出 WXY 1234，查到是月票，闸门就开了。不用票，不用保安。刷脸解锁、Google Lens 也是一样的原理。在你公司：读手写订单或银行单据。车牌脏了、光线差，它可能读错。”

（下一步）语音 AI：“Hey Siri、YouTube 自动字幕、跟你的车讲话。它把声音变成文字。客户发一条语音：Boss, esok hantar 10 carton Milo。它打成文字，变成一张订单。店里吵或口音重，有时会听错。”

（下一步）Diffusion AI，背后是扩散模型：“你有没有在 TikTok 或 YouTube 上看过 AI 短剧？很多根本没有拍过。你打 1 句话：老板发现他的文员是 AI。它从一片噪点开始，就像电视的雪花，每一步清理一点。第 25 步，看得到城市了。第 50 步，完成：第 1 集。Midjourney 和 Sora 也是一样的原理。在你公司：产品照片和宣传视频，不用摄影棚。手、脸和文字还是可能出错，所以发布前先检查。”

（下一步）AI Agent，就是 LLM 加上工具：“这一种直接把工作做完。1 张 WhatsApp 订单：它读订单、在 SQL Account 查库存、草拟 Sales Order，然后等你批准。AI Agent 把前面 4 种当成它的眼睛、耳朵和嘴巴。今天讲的就是它。”

这一页多按 5 次 Next；每张卡片以 3D 飞进来，并播放它自己的小动画。
下一页：“ChatGPT 和每一个 AI Agent 背后的大脑，就是 LLM。我们来打开看看。”

workshop-groups.en:
"Before we start the workshop, let's sit in groups. Look at your name tag: you have a number, 1, 2 or 3. Find the table with your number and sit with your group.

Each group has 1 SuDu coach. Your coach will guide you through every step of the workshop, check your answers with you, and tell you where your company should start. Stuck at any point? Raise your hand, and your coach comes to you."

Do: coaches stand up and hold up their group number so people can find them. Give 2 minutes to move.
Prep: give every participant a name tag with 1, 2 or 3 at registration, spread evenly; put a group number card on each table; say each coach's name out loud here.
Next: "Everyone with your group? Let's start."
workshop-groups.zh:
“工作坊开始之前，我们先分组坐。看看你的名牌：上面有一个号码，1、2 或 3。找到有你号码的桌子，和你的组坐在一起。

每组有 1 位 SuDu 教练。教练会一步一步带你走完工作坊，和你一起核对答案，告诉你公司应该从哪里开始。任何时候卡住了，举手，教练就会过来。”

操作：教练站起来，举起自己的组号，方便大家找到。给 2 分钟换位子。
准备：报到时给每位参加者一个写着 1、2 或 3 的名牌，平均分配；每张桌子放一张组号卡；在这一页念出每位教练的名字。
下一页：“大家都和自己的组坐好了吗？我们开始。”

why-agent.en:
"Why do we need an AI Agent at all? Look at a normal WhatsApp order: Ali wants 2 grade C eggs and 2 grade B eggs. On the left is Mei Ling with a chatbot. It tells her what to do: open SQL Account, create a Sales Order, check the stock, reply to the customer. Helpful, but she still does all the typing. On the right is an AI Agent. It does the job: this is the real Sales Order it drafted in SuDu, customer, items and prices filled in, waiting for 1 click. You just approve. Why can't the chatbot do that? It cannot click, it forgets, it does not know your rules, and nothing stops it. So we give the brain 4 things."

Next: "So let's meet the AI Agent."
why-agent.zh:
“为什么我们需要 AI Agent？看一张普通的 WhatsApp 订单：Ali 要 2 盒 grade C 鸡蛋、2 盒 grade B 鸡蛋。左边是 Mei Ling 在用聊天机器人。它告诉她怎么做：打开 SQL Account、开 Sales Order、查库存、回复客户。有帮助，但打字的还是她。右边是 AI Agent。它直接把事做完：这是它在 SuDu 里真正拟好的 Sales Order，客户、货品、价钱都填好了，只等你按 1 下。你只需要批准。为什么聊天机器人做不到？它不会点击、会忘记、不懂你的规矩，也没有人管着它。所以我们给大脑 4 样东西。”

下一页：“那我们来认识 AI Agent。”

agent-quiz.en:
"Quick quiz before we open it up. 4 jobs. For each one, shout: chatbot, or AI Agent?

Job 1: write a polite reply to a customer who paid late." (let them shout) "Job 2: check if we still have 20 bags of onions. Job 3: explain what an e-Invoice is. Job 4: create the Sales Order and send the DO."

(Next) "Job 1 and job 3: a chatbot can do them. They are just words. Job 2 and job 4 need an AI Agent, because it has to open your system and click. Here is the rule: if the job is only words, a chatbot can help. If the job touches your system, you need an agent."

This slide has 1 extra Next press: the answers.
Next: "So let's meet the AI Agent."
agent-quiz.zh:
“打开它之前，先来个小测验。4 份工作。每一份，大声说：聊天机器人，还是 AI Agent？

工作 1：给迟付款的客户写一封客气的回复。”（让大家喊）“工作 2：查一下还有没有 20 包洋葱。工作 3：解释什么是 e-Invoice。工作 4：开 Sales Order，再发 DO。”

（下一步）“工作 1 和工作 3：聊天机器人就做得到，因为只是文字。工作 2 和工作 4 需要 AI Agent，因为它要打开你的系统去点击。记住这个规则：工作只是文字，聊天机器人能帮忙；工作要碰到你的系统，就需要 AI Agent。”

这一页多按 1 次 Next：公布答案。
下一页：“那我们来认识 AI Agent。”

agent-intro.en:
"So, meet your AI Agent. It is not a chatbot that only talks. Think of it as a new staff member. It reads your WhatsApp messages, opens your systems like SQL Account and Excel, does the job, and asks you before anything is posted.

3 things to remember. It works 24/7: no leave, no MC, no overtime. It uses the systems you already have. And it asks before it acts: nothing goes into your books without you."

Next: "So what is inside it? Let's open it up, as a robot with 5 parts."
agent-intro.zh:
“来，认识你的 AI Agent。它不是只会讲话的聊天机器人。把它想成一位新员工。它读你的 WhatsApp 信息，打开你的系统，比如 SQL Account 和 Excel，把工作做完，而且入账前一定先问你。

记住 3 件事。它全天候工作：不请假、不拿 MC、不用加班费。它用你现有的系统。它先问才动手：没有你，什么都不会进你的账。”

下一页：“那它里面有什么？我们把它打开，画成一个有 5 个部分的机器人。”

good-vs-bad-agent.en:
"Now, not every agent is a good agent. Meet 2 of them. Ah Malas, with his coffee: he only does what you type. And Ah Rajin: he sees the work and starts it before you ask. Same AI inside. Very different staff. Let's follow them through 1 day."

(Next) 9 am: "3 WhatsApp orders come in. Ah Malas? Zzz. Nothing happens until you sit down and type: create the orders. Ah Rajin has already drafted 3 Sales Orders: Boss, approve?"

(Next) 11:30: "Milo stock is down to 2 days. Ah Malas says nothing; you find out when a customer shouts at you. Ah Rajin: Milo runs out on Friday, and the PO to the supplier is already drafted."

(Next) 4 pm: "Kedai Ali is 45 days late. Nobody asked Ah Malas, so he never reminds. Ah Rajin sends a polite reminder and comes back with: RM3,200 promised by Friday."

(Next) "By 5 pm, Ah Malas did 1 job: the 1 you typed. Ah Rajin did 5, all waiting for your OK. And here is the important part: Ah Rajin is still not allowed to post anything on his own. Proactive does not mean out of control. It means he does the preparing, and you do the deciding.

So what makes a good agent? It knows the goal, it watches your data, it acts first, and it still asks you. That is how we set up every SuDu agent."

This slide has 4 extra Next presses: 3 moments of the day, then the score.
Next: "How do you turn the brain into a good staff member? The same way you set up a new hire."
good-vs-bad-agent.zh:
“不是每个 AI Agent 都是好 AI Agent。来认识 2 位。Ah Malas，手上拿着咖啡：你打什么，他才做什么。还有 Ah Rajin：他看到工作，你还没开口就先做。里面是同样的 AI，却是完全不同的员工。我们跟着他们过 1 天。”

（下一步）早上 9 点：“进来 3 张 WhatsApp 订单。Ah Malas？Zzz。你没坐下来打“开订单”，什么都不会发生。Ah Rajin 已经拟好 3 张 Sales Order：老板，批准吗？”

（下一步）11:30：“Milo 库存只够 2 天。Ah Malas 一声不响；客户骂上门你才知道。Ah Rajin：Milo 星期五会卖完，给供应商的 PO 已经拟好了。”

（下一步）下午 4 点：“Kedai Ali 迟付款 45 天。没人叫 Ah Malas，他就从不提醒。Ah Rajin 发出客气的提醒，还带回消息：RM3,200 答应星期五付。”

（下一步）“到下午 5 点，Ah Malas 做了 1 件事：就是你打的那 1 件。Ah Rajin 做了 5 件，全部等你批准。重点是：Ah Rajin 还是不能自己入账。主动不等于失控。意思是他负责准备，你负责决定。

那怎样才是好 AI Agent？它知道目标，它盯着你的数据，它先动手，而且它还是会问你。每一个 SuDu AI Agent 都是这样设置的。”

这一页多按 4 次 Next：一天里的 3 个时刻，再看比分。
下一页：“怎么把大脑变成一位好员工？就像你安排一位新员工那样。”

section-problem.en:
"That is SuDu. Now let's talk about you: the problems businesses like yours face every day. 3 steps.

One: you tell us your biggest problem, right now, on your phone. Two: the top 5 issues we hear most. Three: you put a number on what it costs you."

Next: "Take out your phone."
section-problem.zh:
“这就是 SuDu。现在来讲讲你：像你这样的企业每天遇到的问题。分 3 步。

第一：你现在就用手机告诉我们你最大的问题。第二：我们最常听到的 5 大问题。第三：你算出它让你花了多少钱。”

下一页：“拿出你的手机。”

section-demo.en:
"Enough talking. Let me show you. This is a live demo on a sample company, Maju Jaya Foods, with sample data. 6 AI Agents, 7 parts: setting up, then sales, inventory, purchase, collection, up sales and finance. Watch what each agent does, and where it stops and asks a person."

Next: "First, meet the 6 AI Agents."
section-demo.zh:
“讲够了。我来做给你看。这是用一家示范公司 Maju Jaya Foods 做的现场演示，用的是示范数据。6 个 AI Agent，7 个部分：设置，然后是销售、库存、采购、收款、追加销售和财务。留意每个 AI Agent 做了什么，还有它在哪里停下来问人。”

下一页：“首先，认识 6 个 AI Agent。”

section-workshop.en:
"Now it is your turn. This is the workshop part. 3 steps.

One: find your group, using the number on your name tag. Two: meet your coach; every group has 1 SuDu coach. Three: check your own company: do you need a WMS and an MES?"

Next: "First, find your number."
section-workshop.zh:
“现在轮到你了。这是工作坊环节。分 3 步。

第一：用你名牌上的号码，找到你的组。第二：认识你的教练；每组有 1 位 SuDu 教练。第三：检查你自己的公司：你需要 WMS 和 MES 吗？”

下一页：“首先，找到你的号码。”

courses.en:
"Today was day 1. If you want to go deeper with your team, we have 3 courses coming.

The Smart Warehouse Bootcamp is for storekeepers and warehouse managers: bins, batches and expiry dates, scanning in, picking and packing with WMS, and stock counts that finally match the system.

The Smart Factory Bootcamp is for factory owners and production managers: BOM and work orders done right, tracking every job on the floor, and the real cost and waste of each batch.

And the AI Agent Masterclass is the advanced course: you learn to write rules and skills for your agents, set approvals and permissions, and measure the time and money it saves. Build and run your own AI team.

Dates are coming soon. Tell your coach which one you want, and we will let you know first."

(Next: card 1 opens) "Let me open the first one, the Smart Warehouse Bootcamp: RM399 per person. 4 things you will do: map your warehouse, zones, racks and bins, with batch and expiry for every item. Scan, don't type: receive, put away, pick and pack with the WMS scanner. Count without stopping: cycle counts that match SQL Account, no shutdown day. And let AI watch the stock: Inventory AI warns you before stock runs out or expires. You leave with your own bin map, a scanning flow for your team and a stock count plan."

This slide has 1 extra Next press: card 1 opens.

Note: dates, fees and HRDF status to be confirmed before the seminar.
Next: "And 1 last thing: don't wait."
courses.zh:
“今天是第 1 天。如果你想和团队一起再深入学习，我们有 3 个课程即将开课。

智能仓库训练营适合仓管员和仓库经理：货位、批次和有效期，用 WMS 扫码入库、拣货和包装，还有终于和系统一致的盘点数字。

智能工厂训练营适合工厂老板和生产经理：把 BOM 和工单做对，追踪车间里的每一份工作，还有每一批的真实成本和损耗。

最后，AI Agent 大师班是进阶课程：你会学到怎么为 AI Agent 写规则和技能、设置批准和权限，还有算出它帮你省下多少时间和钱。打造并管理你自己的 AI 团队。

日期即将公布。告诉你的教练你想上哪一个，我们会第一时间通知你。”

（下一步：第 1 张卡片打开）“我先打开第一个，智能仓库训练营：每人 RM399。你会做 4 件事：画出你的仓库，分区、货架和货位，每样货都有批次和有效期。扫码，不用打字：用 WMS 扫描器收货、上架、拣货和包装。不停工也能盘点：循环盘点，数字和 SQL Account 一致，不用停工一天。还有，让 AI 帮你看库存：库存快卖完或快过期前，Inventory AI 会先提醒你。你会带走你自己的货位图、给团队的扫码流程，还有一份盘点计划。”

这一页多按 1 次 Next：打开第 1 张卡片。

备注：日期、费用和 HRDF 资格要在讲座前确认。
下一页：“最后一件事：不要等。”

imagine.en:
(Slow down. Let the room picture it.)

"Let me ask you to imagine something. A day when AI runs your whole company.

Today, AI Agents already run the office: they take the orders, make the invoices, watch the stock and chase the payments. You saw what that looks like.

Next, AI walks onto the floor. Physical AI: robots that pick, pack and build, working next to your people.

And one day, the company runs itself. You set the goal. AI does the rest, and it still asks you before the big decisions.

Sounds far away? It has already started. Watch this."

Next: the video, F.03 at BMW.
imagine.zh:
（放慢速度，让全场去想象。）

“请大家想象一件事。有一天，AI 能运营你的整家公司。

今天，AI Agent 已经在管办公室：接订单、开发票、看库存、追款。刚才你已经看到是什么样子。

下一步，AI 会走进车间。实体 AI：机器人在你的员工身边拣货、包装、组装。

有一天，公司会自己运转。你定目标，其余交给 AI，而且重大决定前它还是会先问你。

听起来很遥远？其实已经开始了。来看这个。”

下一页：视频，F.03 在 BMW。

video-figure.en:
(The video plays: about 1 minute, Figure AI's F.03 robot working on the BMW factory floor. Let it run. Do not talk over it.)

"That is not a movie. That is a real robot, in a real car factory, today."

Do: click the video to pause or play. If it starts with no sound, click it once to turn the sound on.
Next: "That is where the world is going. And that is exactly what SuDu is building."
video-figure.zh:
（视频播放：大约 1 分钟，Figure AI 的 F.03 机器人在 BMW 工厂车间工作。让它播完，不要边播边讲。）

“这不是电影。这是真的机器人，在真的汽车工厂里，就在今天。”

操作：点一下视频可以暂停或继续。如果开始时没有声音，点一下视频就会打开声音。
下一页：“这就是世界要去的方向。而这正是 SuDu 在打造的。”

ai-guru.en:
"Quick question. Once you start using AI, are these problems solved?" (let the room answer; most will say yes)

(Next) "Not necessarily. AI on its own can think. It cannot do."

(Next) "Here is the catch. AI without tools is just a guru. You know the type: very confident, very good advice. You should check your stock first. You should chase Kedai Ali. You should key in your orders faster. Thank you, guru." (pause) "In Chinese we have a phrase for this: 只会讲，不会做. All talk, no action." (let the room laugh)

"AI is the same. On its own, it can only think and suggest. To actually do the work, it needs tools: hands inside your business. That is what SuDu gives it. WMS for the warehouse: it scans, counts and picks your stock. MES for the factory: it tracks every job and every batch. All on top of SQL Account, where your orders, invoices and payments already live. Now the AI checks, counts, keys in and chases, and you approve."

This slide has 2 extra Next presses: the question, then "Not necessarily", then the Guru.
Next: "So with tools, the way we work changes."
ai-guru.zh:
“问大家一个问题。是不是使用了 AI 后，这些问题就能被解决？”（让大家回答；大部分人会说是）

（下一步）“不一定。单靠 AI，只会想，不会做。”

（下一步）“重点来了。没有工具的 AI，只是一位大师。你们都认识这种人：很有自信，建议很好听。你应该先查一下库存。你应该去追 Kedai Ali 的账。你应该打单快一点。谢谢你，大师。”（停一下）“中文有一句话专门讲这种人：只会讲，不会做。”（让大家笑）

“AI 也一样。单靠它自己，只能想、只能给建议。要真的把事做完，它需要工具：伸进你生意里的一双手。这就是 SuDu 给它的。仓库用 WMS：扫码、盘点、拣货。工厂用 MES：追踪每一份工作、每一批货。全部建在 SQL Account 上，你的订单、发票和收付款本来就在那里。这样 AI 才会去查、去点、去打单、去追款，而你来批准。”

这一页多按 2 次 Next：先问问题，再出“不一定”，最后是 AI 大师。
下一页：“所以有了工具，工作方式就不一样了。”

new-way.en:
"So with tools, the way we work changes. The AI Agent does the work: it thinks, it reads the order and plans every step, and it executes: checks the stock, keys in, sends, chases.

And you? You run the rules. You set them: credit limits, prices, who approves what. You monitor: every action on 1 screen. And you approve: nothing is posted without you. Rules go to the AI, reports come back to you.

Before, people did the work and software kept the records. Now, AI does the work, and people run it. That is a new way of working."

Next: "And the part that makes this possible is the tools."
new-way.zh:
“所以有了工具，工作方式就不一样了。AI Agent 负责做事：它会思考，读订单、计划每一步；它也会执行：查库存、打单、发送、追款。

那你呢？你掌管规矩。你定规矩：信用额度、价格、谁批准什么。你监督：每个动作都在 1 个画面上看得到。你批准：没有你，什么都不入账。规矩交给 AI，汇报回到你手上。

以前，人做事，软件记录。现在，AI 做事，人来掌管。这就是全新的工作方式。”

下一页：“而让这一切成真的，就是工具。”

meme.en:
(This one is for a laugh. Let it land.)

"Be honest: who is the boss of your company? Before AI, it is the problems. Staff on leave. High costs. Wrong stock. Slow work. Can't hire anyone. The boss gets beaten up every day." (pause)

"After AI: orders keyed in, stock counted, payments chased, reports done. The AI does the work, and the boss is the boss again."

Next: "And the part that makes this possible is the tools."
meme.zh:
（这一页是给大家笑的，让它停一下。）

“说真的，你公司的老板到底是谁？用 AI 之前，是那些问题。员工请假。高开销。库存不准。低效率。请不到人。老板每天被打。”（停一下）

“用 AI 之后：订单打好了，库存点好了，欠款追好了，报表做好了。AI 在做事，老板又做回老板了。”

下一页：“而让这一切成真的，就是工具。”

meme-img.en:
(This one is for a laugh. Let it land.)

"Be honest: before AI, who is really the boss of your company? The problems. Staff on leave, high costs, wrong stock, slow work, can't hire anyone. After AI, the boss is the boss again, and the AI does the hard work."

Next: "So how does AI help? Let's start with the big question: what is AI, really?"
meme-img.zh:
（这一页是给大家笑的，让它停一下。）

“说真的，用 AI 之前，你公司真正的老板是谁？是那些问题。员工请假、高开销、库存不准、低效率、请不到人。用 AI 之后，老板又做回老板，辛苦的工作交给 AI。”

下一页：“那 AI 能怎么帮忙？我们先从一个大问题开始：AI 到底是什么？”

video-wms.en:

"That is what tools look like in a real warehouse: every carton scanned, every bin known, every count matching the system."

Do: click the video to pause or play. If it starts with no sound, click it once to turn the sound on.
Next: "Before the demo, the 2 questions I get asked the most."
video-wms.zh:
（视频播放：大约 3 分钟，SuDu WMS 预览，有字幕。让它播完。）

“这就是工具在真正的仓库里的样子：每一箱都扫码，每个货位都清楚，每次盘点都和系统一致。”

操作：点一下视频可以暂停或继续。如果开始时没有声音，点一下视频就会打开声音。
下一页：“演示之前，先回答 2 个我最常被问的问题。”

meme-pool.en:
(This one is for a laugh. Let it land.)

"Be honest, admins in the room. The boss is busy playing with the new AI Agent. The admin preparing the report is drowning. And the admin keying in orders? Already at the bottom of the pool, since last year." (pause for the laugh)

"That is exactly why we built SuDu: so nobody in your company has to drown in reports and keying in again."

Next: "Enough talking. Let me show you."
meme-pool.zh:
（这一页是给大家笑的，让它停一下。）

“在座的 Admin，说真的。老板忙着玩新的 AI Agent。准备 Report 的 Admin 快要淹死了。那 Key 单的 Admin 呢？去年就已经沉到池底了。”（停一下让大家笑）

“这就是我们打造 SuDu 的原因：让你公司里没有人再被 Report 和打单淹没。”

下一页：“讲够了。我来做给你看。”

faq.en:
"Before the demo, let me answer the 2 questions I get asked the most, at every seminar.

One: I already have SQL Account, why do I still need SuDu? Two: can I just connect Claude or Codex straight to SQL Account?"

Next: "Question 1."
faq.zh:
“演示之前，我先回答 2 个每场讲座都会被问到的问题。

第一：我已经有 SQL Account 了，为什么还需要 SuDu？第二：我可以直接把 Claude 或 Codex 接到 SQL Account 吗？”

下一页：“第 1 个问题。”

demo-note.en:
"Before we start the demo, 1 quick note. What you are about to see runs on a demo account. In a demo account, we cannot sync the full data from SQL Account, for example the opening ledger, the balances each customer already owes. Collection AI needs exactly that data to know who is overdue. So today, Sales, Inventory, Purchase, Up Sales and Finance AI run live, and for Collection AI I will walk you through the slides instead. On your own account, with your full data synced, Collection AI runs live like the others."

Next: "Before any agent works, we set it up once."
demo-note.zh:
“开始演示之前，先说明一下。接下来大家看到的，是在一个 Demo 账号上运行的。Demo 账号无法从 SQL Account 同步完整数据，例如 Opening Ledger，也就是每位顾客原本就欠的余额。Collection AI 正需要这些数据，才知道谁逾期。所以今天，Sales、Inventory、Purchase、Up Sales 和 Finance AI 会现场运行，Collection AI 的部分我会用幻灯片为大家讲解。用你自己的账号、同步完整数据后，Collection AI 就会像其他 AI Agent 一样现场运作。”

下一页：“任何 AI Agent 开工之前，我们先设置一次。”
